In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

Humans navigate the world with five senses but we sometimes forget there are aspects of this world we can't see, smell, feel, touch, or taste. But some creatures can sense what humans cannot - from animals like the red fox and sea turtle that use the earth's magnetism to get around, to those who can feel seismic vibrations like elephants.

While humans measure and obsess over how to achieve speed in even greater quantities, for Earth's creatures who've had to adapt and evolve to achieve acceleration abilities it often means the difference between life and death. They give new definition to the need for speed.

As he was leaving the company he receives a text message from Yooseon and barges into the meeting saying that he has something to say.

Yooseon appoints Mr. Kim and the Business Operations Department as the team to come up with a revival plan for TQ Delivery. Mr. Kim and the team gets to work in coming up with an appropriate plan. Meanwhile, Yul warns the Business Operations Department that they will be dissolved if the plan they come up with does not meet the expectations.

The Business Operations Department is hesitant to start working on the revival plan project since the team will get dissolved if it doesn't turn out well. In order to stop that from happening, Mr. Kim and Hagyeong gets hard at work and try their best to reveal the corruptions.

Yul dissolves Business Operations Department, and this puts Mr. Kim down. However, his depression doesn't last long and he's once again back to his old self again. Now it's time for him to get back at Yul.

Winning against the battle with Chariman Park, Mr. Kim successfully brings back Business Operations back in one. He also shares the money he received from Yooseon with his co-workers without them knowing that it was him who shared the money. Despite this victory, Mr. Kim still feels uneasy and at the end, he finally realizes what's been bothering him.

The Crown Prince finds out that Eunuch Hong is actually Hong Gyeongnae's daughter, but he cannot believe she approached him on purpose as a spy. He feels so lost and betrayed that he doesn't know what to do. Meanwhile, Raon is also in pain because of the fact that she has to stay far away from him for everyone's sake.

Yeong is heartbroken that he has become the person who only makes life difficult for Raon. He asks Byeongyeon to let him see Raon once more, and Raon meets him just to say goodbye. She pretends as if she became a eunuch on purpose as a rebel so that Yeong would forget about her and not feel apologetic for marrying someone else.

The palace guards capture Hong Gyeongnae alive and prepare for the interrogation. Everyone is shocked to know he is alive, and Raon feels resentful that he didn't even let his family know of his being alive. Meanwhile, Yeong visits Hong Gyeongnae in prison and they discuss the world they dream of.

With Chief Eunuch Han and Byeongyeon's sacrifice, Raon and her father are able to escape from the palace successfully. Byeongyeon gets badly injured, but he recovers slowly with Yunseong and Master Jung's help. Meanwhile, Yunseong warns the Queen to confess that she abandoned the King's baby in order to stay in power.

Premier Kim tries to poison Yeong and make Yunseong a new crown prince, but Yeong recovers from his illness thanks to Master Jung. Also, he finds the evidence on his mother's death with Raon and Princess Yeongeun's help. Premier Kim and the two former ministers are sentenced to death penalty. A year later, Yeong becomes the King who shines brighter among his people.

Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. The Shane Gang are under non-stop ghoul fire as they struggle to put a stop to Tad's plans and end the mass ghouling of slugs once and for all.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 1
programmes.d: 15-year-old Eli Shane is a regular kid except for one thing: he comes from a long line of Shanes, each who has journied from the surface to protect Slugterra and the slugs that make the world special.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 2
programmes.d: Now its Eli's turn to be Slugterra's next Shane, whether he's ready or not! Unfortunately, the slugslinging tournament he enters to prove that he's ready, pretty quickly shows that he's not!

After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.
When the punks in the Hooligang cruise into Quiet Lawn Cavern, they think no one there's got the guts to stand up to them so they trash the place.
The gang signs up for a weekend camp that promises to teach your slugs tons of new moves - without lifting a finger!

The Slug Run is the ultimate, off-road, no-holds-barred, cross-cavern Mecha Beast race. Unfortunately, the only thing lower than the odds of beating the three-time champ who's now racing for Dr. Blakk are the odds of Eli making it to the finish line in one piece!
When even Kord can't find a way to fix what's wrong with the new upgrades to the Shane Gang's Mecha Beasts, it's time to go to the source: the wondrous Mecha Forge!
Eli doesn't believe in ghosts - until he enters Deadweed cavern! But it turns out Eli's first instinct was right.
A short cut takes the Shane Gang through the territory of the Shadow Clan - and try as they might not to, they are discovered and captured by the mysterious creatures.
Pronto is thrown in jail on trumped-up charges by a corrupt judge, and the only chance to break him out is Eli making a one-in-a-million trick shot.

Long thought to be merely a legend, an Enigmo Slug has finally been spotted. The bidding is high for this rarest of all slugs, and so is the competition to be the first grab it! Eli and the gang actually beat Slugterra's most vicious slug hunter to the prize-only to find that the hunter is now hunting them!
After a wild ride on the mysterious Flumes - the Underriver that runs beneath all of Slugterra - the Shane gang find themselves dropped into a sea cavern.

After an accident, Scratch thinks he's an eagle and on the side of Sonic. In order to impress his his new lady love, Scratch assists Sonic in an excursion into Robotnik's Fortress to turn off a dangerous force field.
Sonic turns detective to solve the mystery of his missing Red Sneakers--and just in time to get them back and stop Dr. Robotnik's latest attack on a peaceful Mobius village.
Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him.
Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strenghs.
Mobius is suffering a crime spree and all the evidence points to Sonic as the culprit. But the real thief is a lab rat wearing a high-tech vehicle suit who was sent by Robotnik to discredit our hero.
When Hacker, an adolescent mole computer whiz steals a super-intelligence program from Robotnik's computer, Sonic has to protect him, smashing Grounder to pieces.
Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails.

Robotnik installs a new "obedience microchip" in Scratch and Grounder and orders them to drill for a rare mineral in a tropical mountain. With his Freezomatic machine, Robotnik covers the mountain in ice and runs a Hermit out of his home.

programmes.d: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you've ever eaten.

It's Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much-needed upgrade.
Chef Dale kicks up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.
Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.
Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

It's that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that's grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It's the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

In 2010, Amberly Snyder's life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you'd see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly's story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programmes.st: Deer and Deer Hunting - "Science Of Death

After a night of bloatedness caused by 400 stuffed jalapenos, Dag finds a baby mongoose in his bed and thinks he's given birth.

programmes.st: Muscular Beaver IV / Act Your Age

It Girl: Helga becomes the latest child fashion star and everyone loves her for her scowl and bad attitude.
Deconstructing Arnold: The gang finally gets sick of Arnold's never-ending good advice, so they all decide to stop listening to him all together.

Grudge Match: Arnold and Grandpa vs Helga and Big Bob in a fender bender blame game.
Polishing Rhonda: Rhonda and Patty's rivalry heats up at finishing school.

programmes.t: Hey Arnold!: Back to School/Egg Story
programmes.d:
Back To School: Grandpa returns to grade school so he can finally fulfill his dream of graduating.
Egg Story: Mr. Simmons gives the class an assignment to couple up and take care of an egg over the weekend to learn teamwork and responsibility.

Weird Cousin: Arnold's weird cousin, Arnie, arrives for a visit and appears to be the biggest loser to everyone except Lila, the love of Arnold's life.
Baby Oskar: Oskar's wife Susie agrees to watch her cousin's baby, also named Oskar.

When Eliza tries to swim with the humpback whales, Darwin's clumsiness leads to an accident that causes the whales to stop their ritual singing. When Eliza tries to set things right, she is arrested for violating the Marine Mammal Protection Act.

Eliza and her father travel to a cove to film a rare fish,  but Eliza is frightened by strange voices coming from a bog and convinces her father to take a different route. But when Nigel is stung by a deadly fish, Eliza must go back through the bog.

When Eliza meets a group of temple monkeys, they con her into bringing all of her family's food. While Darwin tries to convince her otherwise, Eliza realizes that she's been duped and learns the value of Darwin's friendship.
The Thornberrys are invited on a cattle drive by Marianne's old high school friend. Though he talks a big talk, their son, Miguel, is not as adept at riding and roping as he claims.
The Thornberrys are visited by the Foundation head's son, Tom, who splits the Nigel and Marianne team up. An overzealous Tom treats Eliza like a child until he lands the Commvee in a raging river.
During a drought, Eliza is forbidden to assist the thirsty animals, but she breaks her promise when she sees a cheetah cub alone on the savanna.

Eliza and a Chinese girl, Arioka, secretly switch places so Eliza can ride across the desert on camels and Arioka can ride in the Commvee, but Arioka's parents change their plans, and Eliza must figure out a way to get them back to the Thornberrys.

Helga Sleepwalks: Helga begins to sleepwalk and ends up walking to Arnold's house. 
Fighting Families: The Fighting Families Contest has come to town and have selected two families: one from PS 118 and PS 119.

Monkeyman!: Arnold is saved from thugs by a mysterious, caped character named Monkeyman.
Buses, Bikes, Subways: Out on a field trip, Harold and Helga miss the bus and get separated from the rest of the class.

Grandpa's sister: Mitzi arrives unexpectedly at the boarding house.
Synchronized Swimming: Coach Wittenberg recruits Arnold's gang for a synchronized swim team.

programmes.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga's Masquerade/Mr. Green Runs
programmes.d:

Mr. Green Runs: Arnold helps Mr. Green run for the City Council.

programmes.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga On The Couch
programmes.d: Helga is recommended for counseling after Mr. Simmons observes her berating Arnold, arguing with her parents, etc. She learns that unrequited love is very normal and that she's actually okay.

Washed up balladeer Dino Spumoni fakes his own death in order to increase his record sales.  Everyone believes he's dead and at the funeral, Grandpa and Arnold find out that Dino has left Arnold all his future record sales.

Action star Mack Granite picks Kimi to audition for a part in his next movie. / When Taffy comes to babysit but is in an artistic funk, and Angelica enters dressed (and acting) like Taffy, the babies think they've swapped identities.

programmes.st: They Came From The Backyard/Lil's Phil of Trash

Chuckie’s puppy is sad, and Chas thinks it’s because she doesn’t have a name. Betty’s college roommate comes to visit with her daughter Alice, just as weather reports forecast a hurricane also called Alice.

Stu, Chas, Angelica, and Susie enter Spiffy, Puppy, Fluffy, and Herbie the gerbil, respectively, in a pet show, all vying for the "Best Pet" honor. / Taffy takes the babies to their first fast-food restaurant.

Zoey's date gets put on hold when the girls are quarantined in their room after Quinn releases an unidentified germ in their room. Meanwhile, Quinn who has her own romantic dilemma involving Mark.

Chase inherits an old radio that belonged to his grandfather, but rather than keep it, he sells it to Zoey for five bucks and a taco coupon. Zoey soon realizes that the radios value is worth much more then she bargained for.
A science star considers attending PCA, prompting Quinn to rebel when she realizes that she may no longer be the smartest girl on campus. Meanwhile, Michael thinks he is going crazy.
An uncoordinated Chase enters a dance contest with Zoey after her first partner breaks a leg. Meanwhile, Lola fools a crush into thinking she's British.
The kids and their parents are at Camp Everwood. Chance, a camp counselor, is staging an elaborate musical while Dil is discovering whether or not the camp is haunted.
The kids take an aptitude test to get a clue as to what they want to be when they grow up, but they are not thrilled about the results.
Charlotte lets Angelica redesign her room. The first step: throwing out all the toys. Unfortunately, that also includes Cynthia, Angelica's favorite doll.
An older girl, Francine, picks on Tommy. And Angelica loves every minute of it! Is it possible that Francine likes Tommy, or is she just a pest?
Kimi becomes obsessed with her Japanese heritage when she and the gang have to research their family trees as a school project.

Angelica's been invited to Savannah's party so she has to find a dress that hasn't ABW (Already Been Worn). While working at the hospital she suddenly breaks her nose and fakes a dilemma. Meanwhile the other kids are doing community service.
Susie is forced to choose between singing success in a TV talent show and leading her language team to victory in the language bowl, which is held on the same day.

When Chuckie's biggest competition for School Safety Commissioner is Dil's imaginary alien friend, Izzy, you would think he would have it in the bag. But when Izzy becomes more popular than Chuckie, can he rely on his friends to help him win?

The pressure is on as the guys prepare for their first band photo, which could land them into all the teen magazines.
Spending all their time together since moving to LA has given guys cabin fever, so they decide to spend some time apart.
It's been three months since the boys of Big Time Rush moved to Hollywood to record their demos. Now it's up to Griffin to decide the future of the band.
After learning that Gustavo is hosting a party at the studio that the boys are not invited to, they guys decide to host their own party at the Palm Woods.
The guys are continuing to live their Hollywood dream, however James, Logan & Carlos begin showing odd behavior.
When Mr. Nichols boss calls off their dinner plans because of a last minute babysitter cancellation, Josh volunteers his and Drake's services.
After Drake agrees to help Josh with his girl troubles, Josh finds himself promising to play a birthday song at his crush's party.
When the parents leave town for the weekend, Drake and Josh's excitement is stunted when they learn that Grammy is coming to stay.
Drake bets that he can last longer without junk food than Josh can without video games. Who will win.
Drake receives tickets to a concert and a guitar autographed by his idol. Josh accidentally destroys the guitar and to cover it up has to buy a new one.
Josh and Drake both get a job at the Movie Theater and works toward the coveted assistant manager position.
Drake convinces Josh that in order to become cooler he must try out for the football team.
Mr. Madigan discovers a new prodigy, but True suspects that he's up to no good.
Lulu suspects that her boyfriend is interested in someone else.
True gets a big assignment at work on the same day she goes back to school. True finds it difficult to juggle school and work.
As a result of bumbling, Kenan and Kel find themselves trapped in a freezer.  Oh, they're also trapped in there with Roger, Sheryl, Kyra, a restaurant full of customers and Dr. Joyce Brothers.
Eager to see the gifts his parents brought him for his birthday, Kenan snoops around and ultimately finds it.

Boruto and Naruto resume their training.

Boruto's quick thinking exposes Urashiki's trick that enables him to see into the future and they manage to inflict some damage
The battle against Urashiki is over, and it's time for Boruto and Sasuke to return to the place where they rightfully belong.

It takes nine years and the work of cutting-edge forensic toxicologists to solve the murder of a medical examiner's wife. Then, a determined Alabama sheriff reopens the case of the deaths of two babies, hoping to get their mother to confess.
March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

A killer authors a book about his con-man past that becomes the key to solving a 29-year-old cold case of two high school sweethearts--and three other cold case murders--leading police to believe he could be the Zodiac Killer.
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Oklahoma. DNA points to her killer over a decade later and leads investigators across state lines.

Guns found dumped in a pond help police to solve the 15-year-old murder of Detroit cab company owner. And the rape and murder of an Atlanta TV station receptionist goes cold for 20 years before DNA links a man to the crime.
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but her sister Linda vows to solve her murder.

After 19 years, Kansas detectives reopen the case of a banker found beaten to death in his bed--and the chief suspect is his cheating wife. And a man with a guilty conscience helps Arkansas police to crack a cold case of murder.
Bill Kurtis examines one of the most infamous cold cases in Los Angeles history.

Looks at how law enforcers stick with cases for many years, using fresh evidence to win convictions or to free prisoners who were wrongfully jailed. We examine the unsolved murder of Hogan's Heroes star Bob Crane.

In June 1985, a 20-year-old "Sucker Day" Festival Queen is found brutalized. The small community of Nixa, Missouri, is certain her blood is on the hands of a local wealthy businessman, but after 25 years DNA reveals the true killer.

In 1983, Navy seamen Sonny Grotton left base for a long weekend at home. But as he pulled into his driveway, a gunman killed him. And in 1993, former state trooper Doug Wright claimed his estranged wife shot and killed herself in their home.

When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace. A decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

13 days after Pam Pitts disappears in 1988 her charred body is found at a popular hangout spot in the Arizona desert. When a second victim is discovered in a mineshaft, detectives suspect the killer may have known them both.

The daughter of one of Mark's friends writes a juicy tell-all expose of the most prominent public figures. Mark takes her in after a crazed stalker starts threatening her and her co-authors.
Mark investigates a perky morning television personality for the murder of a Howard Stern-like radio host.
Dr. Sloan is the executor of his friend, Preston Michael's, estate after Michaels is found in the body of a shark.

The Master and the Doctor fight for control over Kamelion's mind.

Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate.
Mestor's true plan is revealed.

Nate Brouwer and Charnae Wright bonded through their love of dogs and the outdoors, but their feuding dogs are threatening to tear them apart.
A dog trained to sniff out contraband cell phones in prisons is unable to do his job due to his skittish nature; a dog is terrified of hot air balloons.
A Dogo Argentino with canine aggression; a terrier/corgi mix who becomes aggressive when faced with traveling.
Mufasa, a South African boerboel, became aggressive after being pinned down by another dog; Tucker, a teacup poodle's behavior became more aggressive.
A couple with three unruly dogs, one with aggression issues; a poodle who fears the back door since running into the screen door; a Weimaraner who is territorial and aggressive.
A border collie is overprotective of his owner; a German shepherd is aggressive toward other dogs and people.
An Australian shepherd/pit bull mix with severe aggression issues; a boxer's owners are concerned by her tendency to jump the six-foot backyard fence.
Cesar helps a man get over a fear of dogs so he can finally fulfill his children's request to adopt one of their own.

programmes.st: My Life on the Dog List
programmes.d: Cesar helps actor and comedian Kathy Griffin with her two rescue dogs, Chance and Pom Pom, who are disobedient and territorial.
Two troubled dogs, and their families, win sessions with Cesar after auditioning at a pet store in Orange County, Calif.
A Doberman/Lab and a pit bull develop behavioral issues after not being walked for months; an Italian greyhound acts aggressively toward the men of the house.
Dave Glassman adopts pit bulls Blackjack and Memphis together, but one day during a barking fit, the two dogs turn on each other.
Cesar works to dial down the bad behaviors of four problem dogs who won sessions at the PETCO auditions.
Cesar celebrates the show's 100th episode with a grand reunion of many of the past guests and their dogs.

Dachshund Lotus is very territorial; his aggression sends his owner Chari to the hospital; Cesar makes a house call to see Joey, a German Shepherd who is territorial over the second story of his owner's home.
A French bulldog is nervous around other dogs and occasionally nips at people; a Vizsla who resists going outside due to her fear of cars.
A couple's Chihuahua mix terrorizes their mastiff and dominates the house; a pit bull is not growing out of his puppy behavior.

All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day!  But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programmes.st: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL
programmes.d: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
Dora and Boots are exploring in the forest when they discover the gate to Fairy-Tale Land and enter this magical place. But...there's a mean witch who lives in Fairy-Tale Land.
Yo ho ho! Dora and Boots and all their friends are putting on a pirate show today for their mommies and daddies.
Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick, and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

It's Twins Day, and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too—a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

"Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

Benny is so excited—it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-karts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.
Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever—and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited because this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

"Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the shoe shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots—these are bouncy boots.
Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ball players. A long time ago in a Mayan kingdom, there was a big ball game championship.

programmes.st: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies
programmes.d: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks, and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!

programmes.st: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
programmes.d: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!

It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, and Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

It's naptime for the twins, and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap, but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big pirate treasure hunt, but his piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates—yay!

Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish, but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas fall down on Boots.
Swiper is on Santa's naughty list! Dora believes Swiper can change and has to travel into the past and future to help him find 4 missing ornaments and learn the true meaning of Christmas.
Happy Birthday, Dora!  In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.
Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A greedy king has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.
Dora, Boots, and the snowflake fairy are off to save La Princessa Sabrina and her snowy forest from a mean witch who's locked her in a tower and taken away her magic snow crystal.
Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the moon before the sun rises.

Happy Birthday, Super Babies! It's the Twins' 1st birthday, and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a cake-snatching bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.
Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!
The government puts a price on Sully’s head when he organizes an escape for Cloud Dancing that results in a deadly massacre.
Everyone but Michaela assumes that Sully is dead when he disappears after a fight with his nemesis, Sgt. O’Connor.
Sully struggles to survive in the wilderness as Dr. Mike desperately searches for him.
Dr. Mike hides Sully to protect him from the army who wanted to arrest him but believe he is dead.
Indian attacks continue in Colorado Springs as Hank names himself sheriff, determined to prove Sully is alive.
Dr. Mike, who believes she may be pregnant again, broods about Sully’s fate at the hands of the army.
Dr. Mike is dismayed when a Russian princess who claims to be a psychic mesmerizes the town.
Dr. Mike must help Grace and Robert E. realize that their adopted son may die from his mysterious illness.
Dr. Mike’s sister returns to town to champion prohibition, just as Jake’s self-doubts about Teresa send him on an uncontrollable drinking spree.
Dr. Mike risks her life to battle a deadly diphtheria epidemic that threatens the town and her own family.
Tragedy hovers over Dr. Mike’s family, and Daniel falls seriously ill, as the diphtheria epidemic continues to rage.
Dr. Mike must judge her neighbors when litigation fever strikes Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike tries to mediate a treaty with the Indians despite the arrival of a famed Indian hater.
The approach of Christmas finds Dr. Mike and Sully far from home, while Daniel ponders an offer to leave Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike is shot point blank by a man with a grudge against doctors.
Colleen finds herself the subject of a fatal attraction.
Dr. Mike is sworn to secrecy when she learns that Loren plans to move away for good.
Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.
Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

Steven announces he is moving out of the mansion; the chauffeur, Michael, tells Blake of Steven's affair with Claudia; Fallon resumes relations with Michael, until Blake has the chauffeur worked over; Lindsay sees her mother with Steven.
Blake learns Krystle pawned her emerald necklace to help out Matthew; Fallon tells Jeff she married him solely for her father's welfare; Steven's former lover, Ted, arrives in Denver.
Steven tells Claudia he spent the night with Ted; Krystle leaves Blake; seeing Ted embrace his son, Blake strikes him; Steven accuses his father of murder.
Blake must stand trial for the murder of Steven's lover; Krystle returns home to be with Blake. Fallon testified in her father's behalf but Steven refutes her statements in court.

On the witness stand, Blake maintains his innocence; Matthew learns of Claudia's affair with Steven; Claudia and daughter Lindsay are involved in an automobile accident; The prosecution calls in a mysterious witness that Blake is surprised to see.
Blake's first wife Alexis testifies that Blake is capable of violence; Matthew takes off with Lindsay; Alexis tells Steven of her love for him; the jury announces they have reached a verdict.
Blake is found guilty; Krystle reunites with her husband; Blake strikes Steven; a pregnant Krystle suffers a fall; Alexis moves onto the Carrington estate.
Krystle orders Alexis from the mansion; Blake instructs his attorney to cut Steven out of his will; Claudia attempts suicide; Alexis tells Steven that he is Blake's only child.
Alexis tells Cecil Colby that Fallon is his daughter; Blake and Steven are urged to reconcile; Dr. Toscanni pulls an unconscious Steven from the pool and rushes him to the hospital.

Steven returns to the mansion to recover from injuries sustained by his fall; Krystle's niece, Sammy Jo, arrives to spend a few weeks with the Carrigtons; Alexis hires a private investigator to delve into Krystle's past.

Nick reveals to his sister that Blake is responsible for the death of their younger brother; Sammy Jo and Steven spend the night together; Alexis shoots at Krystle's horse, causing her to be thrown to the ground and hospitalized.
Krystle loses her baby; Steven and Sammy Jo begin dating, although Steven is in love with Claudia. Fallon continues her affair with Nick, and is jealous to find him visiting Krystle in the hospital.

Fallon learns she is pregnant and tells Jeff she is having an abortion; he agrees to divorce her but only if she bears the child. Krystle remains despondent over the loss of her baby; Claudia takes a job with Denver-Carrington.

Alexis tricks Blake into coming to Rome and further traps him by hiring a gossip photographer to snap suggestive photos of the two; Jeff begs Fallon to cancel her abortion; as Nick confronts Krystle, his consolation gives way to passion.

Ethan discovers Tilda's plan to kill him, but gets the upper hand, interrogates her, and learns the truth. Marty forces a captured Mia to use the flash drive. Harper deals with the aftermath of the task force being shot up.

Ethan, Marty, and Mia scramble to get enough money to keep the Russian mob off their back. Harper and Patrick's investigation leads them to Tilda's dead body and Marty. Marlon fights for his relationship with Zipporah.
A wealthy New York couple disappears in a northern Michigan wilderness and Jess and Brooke investigate.
Jess deals with a family crisis while Brooke looks into the disappearance of a mental institution patient.
The prime suspect in a new case is someone Brooke was unable to convict previously.
Jess goes undercover at a military academy after a cadet disappears.
Sage Odom's tour auditions get underway; Uncle Al tries to save the twins; Collette and East-O's turbulent past comes to a head.
Realizing what it takes to become professional dance squad; Rigo has questions after Eart-o's death.
The rivalry between Tal and Zo comes to a head; Davis meets Odalie's parents.
The Calloways upgrade to a spacious new mansion; team owner Jimmy Flaherty attaches serious strings to Cam's max deal.
Cam and M-Chuck are scrutinized by a district attorney; Uncle Julius feuds with a neighbor who won't take responsibility for his dog's actions.
Cassie returns to the dating world and her determination to get what she wants sets her on a collision course with Cam; Reggie meets the peculiar and brilliant man who made Flaherty all his money.

Reggie meets a college football prospect with a troublesome manager; M-Chuck becomes involved in the life of a pregnant girl.
Chen attempts to woo Cassie at a gala to celebrate the launch of Cam's shoe; Cam makes a mistake with a reporter.
The Bishop plans a romantic surprise for Lady Mae; Lady Mae learns that her name is being erased from the scholarship fund at Calvary and sets out to protect her legacy.

Lady Mae and Bishop throw an impromptu party to subvert Harmony and Hope's plans for Calvary; Charity's loyalties are questioned; Grace navigates between playing the obedient pastor for Judee Whitmore and her parents' schemes.

Bishop moves to prevent Judee Whitmore's proposed governance structure; Jacob and Kerissa attempt to mend their wounds; a secret about Phil threatens his relationship with Charity; Grace realizes that what is right has never been less clear.

programmes.st: You Get What You Pay For
programmes.d: Howard decides the house needs a second bathroom. Fonzie offers a way to have it installed and save Howard money as well.

His friends are baffled when Fonzie refuses to speak in his own defense after he is accused of manhandling a student and brought before the school board's disciplinary court.
Joanie tries to help an angry fifteen year old girl kick a drug habit that threatens to get her kicked out of school.
Over the protests of Richie, whose parents are out of town, Potsie invites three-stranded beauty pageant contestants to spend the night.

Laverne and Shirley want to buy a new couch and find out about a furniture sale in a house Shirley says is haunted. When they and Lenny and Squiggy go to buy the couch, they find out she may be right.

The girls take up the odd job of selling house plants door to door, after getting laid off from Shotz. They run into an odd assortment of bizarre tenants who have varied reactions to their sales pitch.
The girls work as temps to save for a cruise. They deal with a bratty boy, but they make it long enough to finally get aboard and say bon voyage. They discover Len and Squig have stowed away.
The girls are happy to head out on their first plane trip ever, but their smiles are turned upside down when their pilot passes out. Leaving it up to one of them to take over the controls.
Shirley's new boyfriend asks Laverne out behind her back. This later leads to a fight between the two. Will they stop arguing long enough to see that their friendship is worth more than one man?

The girls shop in a toy store for a friend. Laverne sees a toy robot and plays with it. The robot blows a fuse though and attacks her. Leading the girls to sue the toy company - but the girls discover the law can be as unfeeling as that robot.

Dressed as Alice in Wonderland for a local children's play, Shirley ends up going to the hospital instead to get her appendix out. Her fear causes her to run and hide, so the gang must find her before her appendix fails her for good.

Two FBI agents use the girls' apartment to stake out criminal activity across the street. When the suspect gets outside their window the girls are shocked to see Carmine with him. Has Carmine gone bad or is there another explanation?

Laverne and Shirley get reacquainted with Ms. Babish's mentally challenged daughter, Amy, who's visiting from her special school. Lenny meets Amy and immediately comes to like her, despite people's protests about what's best for Amy.

It's New Years Eve 1959 and 1960 is shortly due. In the final hours, Laverne's date cancels, Shirley's sick, and Lenny and Squiggy have a special plan for midnight outside the apartment building. Will Laverne leave the '50s in tears or cheers?

The Malachi brothers sabotage Pinky's car the night before the demolition derby.
A short-tempered sergeant loses his tenuous grasp on discipline when the Fonz reports to the army recruitment center soon after draftees Richie, Ralph and Potsie check in for physicals.

Drew's new girlfriend Lily moves in with him, but Drew has a hard time coping with her sleeping habits.
Drew wants to propose to Lily, but Kellie suggests Drew let Lily see what he's really like before proposing.
Lily's mother learns about Drew's previous marriages and wants to cancel Drew and Lily's wedding.
After Lily left Drew at the altar, he realized Kellie was his true love - but Drew can't get Kellie to commit.
Drew goes to extremes while coaching his nephew Gus in soccer, but Gus's aggressive play scares his teammates.
Drew's fun work environment worsens after his relaxed boss Evan leaves for a yoga retreat.
Drew and Kellie reach a milestone in their relationship when they exchange house keys.
When Kellie makes a big announcement, Drew becomes even more determined to convince Kellie to commit.
When Drew's dad dies, Drew is devastated, but he's even more upset after reading his late father's journal.
As Drew and Kellie worry about their impending parenthood, Drew, Lewis, and Oswald go on a drinking tour.
Drew feels he can no longer control his nephew Gus's behavior, as Kellie fears Drew won't make a good father.
Kellie can't drink alcohol while pregnant, so Drew promises to stop, but that proves difficult.
Kellie feels sorry for a lonely couple who just moved in and insists Drew become friends with the husband.
Drew wants to give Kellie her dream vacation to Italy, but he only has $1,000 for the trip.
Kellie wants Drew and her father Don to bond, so she suggests the men go into business together.
When Drew needs to earn more money to support his future baby, Lewis formulates a scheme.
When bus driver Tony has an accident, he begs Drew to lie about it so he won't get fired.
Kellie feels ugly while pregnant, so Drew tries to charm her into feeling better.
In the aftermath of his wedding disaster, Drew tries to sort out his true feelings for Kellie.

programmes.st: Straight Eye for the Queer Guy

Despite their great sex life, Drew and Kellie's opposite political views cause problems in their relationship.
Kellie hates strip clubs, so a guilty Drew lies about going to one with Lewis and Oswald.
When Mimi begins dating Larry, Drew hopes Mimi will finally leave, but Mimi's estranged husband Steve returns.
As Drew plans his proposal to Kellie, he seeks out her parents to ask for her grandmother's engagement ring.
When Drew and Mimi search through their boss's e-mail messages, they realize the store is nearing bankruptcy.
In the series finale, Drew and Kellie leave their wedding rehearsal dinner just before Kellie goes into labor.

programmes.st: Some Of Their Planes Are Missing
programmes.d: The Germans have whipped up a plot to send German pilots in RAF fighters to shoot down British bombers.
Hogan and his men must destroy a German anti-aircraft artillery unit so that the Allies can send in a bombing raid on Hitler's birthday.
In a plot to get to an airplane with a silent engine, Hogan gets Klink to believe that he is psychic.
Klink nabs a spy, so Hogan takes the focus off his catch by making Klink think someone's trying to kill the commandant himself, leading Klink to have Hogan become a decoy commandant.
The Allies give Hogan a solo mission: attend a baron's party as Commandant Klink. Burkhalter gets involved when he learns that Klink's name sits at the very top of the guest list.

programmes.st: Will the Real Colonel Klink Please Stand Up Against the Wall?
programmes.d: When Carter, in the disguise of the camp kommandant, is seen leaving Stalag 13, Klink could end up being tried for treason.
After Klink finds Sergeant Schultz drunk he gets a tough new replacement.
Newkirk sneaks a beautiful woman into camp who turns out to be a Gestapo agent.

A German truck carrying an experimental jet fuel is the latest target for Hogan and his men. But when all efforts to sabotage the shipment fail, Carter gets down to business with the remaining weaponry at hand - a bow and arrow.

While trying to free the underground agent "Tiger" in Paris, Hogan must seek help from a Parisian fortune teller and also enlist the aid of a man who is a look-alike for Nazi Police Chief Heinrich Himmler!
The heroes try to prevent the Gestapo from sending Klink and Schultz to the Russian front.
Planting a fuel depot right outside Stalag 13,a German general is tempting Hogan. Marya the White Russian also shows up again.

programmes.st: How To Cook A German Goose With Radar
programmes.d: A new prisoner in a corporal's uniform turns out to be a general with a mission for Hogan.
The Germans have stolen a gold shipment from the French and Hogan must convince Klink to have it moved to the safety of Stalag 13.
LeBeau is passed off as a Gypsy fortune teller to help get a radar countermeasure device to London.

programmes.st: Praise The Fuerher And Pass The Ammunition
programmes.d: Nearby war games inspire Hogan to replace some of the blank German ammunition with live ammo, using Klink's birthday as a diversion.
Hogan provides information to a German baroness that includes phony invasion plans.
An Italian officer helps Hogan photograph a new German anti-aircraft gun.
General Burkhalter comes to Stalag 13 determined to marry off his sister to Klink. Hogan has to find a planted German agent in the Underground.

programmes.st: Who Stole My Copy of Mein Kampf?
programmes.d: Klink is getting an award from a lovely Allied defector and Hogan plans to get to her first.
Hogan helps Klink prepare for a hasty trip to Argentina when he finds himself in a duel.
While awaiting word to complete a sabotage mission, Stalag 13 gets a new officer under Klink - Burkhalter's alert brother-in-law, who enjoys tormenting prisoners.

Suspecting a security leak at Stalag 13, Gen. Burkhalter goes fishing with some false information and Col. Hogan falls for the bait. As a result, Burkhalter plants a spy among the prisoners to expose the guilty parties.

An assertive Gen. Burkhalter "requisitions" the famous Édouard Manet painting, "The Fife Player," from the Louvre museum in Paris to give to Hermann Goering as a birthday present. Undaunted by seemingly impossible logistics, Hogan and LeBeau decide to ste
Hogan goes to the hospital to get information from a wounded contact.
In using Schultz to deliver radio parts to the underground, Hogan causes a marital tiff, which, to fix, requires getting Klink to believe that his sergeant is dying from premature old age.
Schultz is now the temporary Kommandant of Stalag 13 and starts to abuse his new power.

The aristocratic Colonel Klink fails a routine physical exam and lands a combat assignment at the Russian front! Fearing a hard-line replacement at Stalag 13, the men must do all they can to rescind Klink's marching papers.

programmes.st: Is There a Doctor in the House?
programmes.d: Klink's illness causes problems for one of Hogan's plots.

The Heroes enlist the daughter of a German general to get to photograph his secret plans.
An American journalist is rescued by Hogan; he is sworn to secrecy and sent back to the States.

All this week judges Mich Turner and Peter Sidwell are scrutinising bakeries from Scotland and North West England and today it’s the turn of three bakeries from Lancashire and Merseyside.

It’s the Southern regional final, and the four bakeries that won this week’s heats are back to do battle once more. They’re summoned by the Judges, Mich Turner MBE and Peter Sidwell, and must bake side by side in the same kitchen for the first time.
The competition to find the best independent bakeries continues with judges Mich Turner MBE and Peter Sidwell heading to the East Midlands and Staffordshire.
In tonight's first episode Mary shows us how to prepare and get ahead for the Christmas season. Being such a busy time of year, it's ideal to have just the right dish on standby.

Tonight Mary takes inspiration from a great British tradition, growing your own on the allotment. Mary’s father turned his flowerbeds over to growing veg for the war effort and ever since then, Mary has been hooked on growing her own fruit and veg.
One of Mary’s pleasures is to shop for fresh, exciting, seasonal ingredients, and tonight; it’s the local farmers' market that inspires Mary.
Tonight Mary is inspired by her love of the great British countryside. Brought up in the country, Mary still loves to go walking with her dogs and family, as well as forage for wild ingredients.

The Mertzes and Ricardos feel that their marriages are in a rut and they decide to follow the advice of a book and take a brief vacation from each other. The women move in together as do the guys but they soon all find that they miss each other.

Lucy and Ethel's club must put on an operetta to commemorate its 25th anniversary. However, Lucy, the club treasurer, admits to Ethel that for the past couple of years, she has been mismanaging both the club's budget and her own household budget.

For the Mertzes' twenty-fifth wedding anniversary, Lucy and Ricky present them with a television set. As they are watching it, Ricky's constant adjustments cause the set to explode. Fred gets even by kicking in the Ricardos' TV set.

Lucy and Ethel enter a contest for new home furnishings. If they are the lucky winner, they must be home the next day to receive a phone call. Unfortunately Ricky has four tickets to a new musical which he really wants to see.

The Tropicana club is about to re-open under new management and is looking to Ricky to put on the best possible show. The only problem is that Ricky has come down with a terrible case of laryngitis, and is unable to talk, much less sing.

Not feeling well, Lucy takes herself to the doctor and receives the happy news that she is pregnant. Ethel and Fred find out before Ricky and eagerly begin dreaming about being the lucky godparents. Getting the news to Ricky is not as easy.

A doting husband and father-to-be, Ricky makes the mistake of giving more attention to the arriving baby than he does to his fickle wife. Ricky tries to please Lucy by making her waffles and he doubles his efforts by giving Lucy baby gifts.

Ricky is holding auditions for a new revue he's putting on at the Tropicana. Ricky tells Fred and Ethel that they should audition, but a pregnant Lucy wants part of the spotlight as well. Ricky doesn't go for the idea, so Lucy sneaks into an audition.

Wanting to provide the best environment possible for her child, Lucy decides that she and Ricky should learn to speak proper English. Lucy makes a deal with a tutor who will teach English to the Ricardos.

After members of her club throw her a baby shower, Lucy realizes that Ricky has become jealous of the attention she and the baby are receiving. She consults with a doctor when Ricky complains about nausea, dizziness, and stomach ache.

Lucy decides that their unborn child should have artistic leanings, so she takes up sculpting. The fast-talking salesman in the art supply store she visits sells her an enormous amount of modeling clay, claiming she has talent.

With her baby due any moment, Lucy finds it challenging trying to remain calm given Ricky's nervous behavior. When she asks the Mertzes to come over to offset Ricky, she winds up with three very anxious people.
Lucy gets caught up in a tormenting cycle of buying a useless appliance from a fast-talking salesman, then trading it in for something more expensive when trying to return it.

Could it be? Is Lucy Ricardo not funny? When Lucy's jokes fail to crack a smile amongst her friends and husband, she begins to develop an inferiority complex. Her depression gets worse when she discovers she's no good at bridge.

Ethel flashes back to the time when she and Lucy raced to win the presidency of their club, the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League. When Ethel was nominated for the position, Lucy bribed another member to nominate her.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are out a restaurant and Lucy keeps changing her order and their seating. Ricky points out that she constantly changes her mind and never completes things.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Lucy and Ricky are exhausted from walking the baby at night and hire a maid. Lucy prepares a list of dos and don'ts in order to set down the law for her new employee. However when Mrs. Porter arrives, she has her own list for her employer.

Lucy wants to get into the act when Ricky is producing an Indian show at the Tropicana. Ricky instead hires the Mertzes to be part of the show, hoping Lucy will be cured of her show biz bug now that she is a mother.
Ricky has planned a surprise party for Lucy's birthday and swears the Mertzes and all their friends to secrecy. Lucy, however, only knows that everyone has forgotten her birthday.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.
Without consulting Ricky, Lucy buys new living room furniture, using their old set as a down payment. Waiting for the right moment to tell Ricky the news, she hides the new furniture in the kitchen.

Lucy feels that she and Ricky are growing apart because they don't share many of the same interests. To make up for this, Lucy decides to invite herself along to a camping trip that Ricky and Fred are going on.

programmes.st: Ricky and Fred Are TV Fans
programmes.d: Dismayed that they can't seem to unglue their husbands from the boxing match on TV, Lucy and Ethel decided to go out for a bite to eat. However, at the local café they run into a similar problem.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.
Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.

After watching two women walk out of a local dress shop with $200 in purchases, Lucy and Ethel decide to buy the shop and go into business for themselves. The first signs of trouble begin when they can't agree on a name for their store.

programmes.st: Lucy and Ethel Buy A Dress
programmes.d: The annual talent show for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League is going to be televised this year, and Lucy and Ethel are going to perform a duet. Everything is going well as Lucy gets Ricky to emcee the show and help her and Ethel prepare.
treated as if they were men. Later on, when the two couples go out to dinner, Fred and Ricky follow the ladies' instructions.

Ricky's friend Charlie Appleby and his wife Caroline are coming over for dinner at the Ricardos. Charlie is going to have Ricky emcee a TV program he's working on and so Ricky wants to make a good impression at dinner.

The pressure is on when both Team Peck and Team Nunez must work in pairs to transform their canvases into warriors in the Elimination Tattoo.
Team Nunez uses live wires to create art pieces in an electrifying Flash Challenge, and a gendered alliance has the women out for blood.
Team Peck fights for control of the game in a Flash Challenge testing contrast, and one artist turns the tables on the women's alliance.
The artists must tattoo former smokers who have been scarred for life, and the six remaining artists on Team Nunez battle for a spot in the team's top five.

The artists must ink their canvases' heads in an intense two-day long Elimination Tattoo, and the battle between alliances heats up.

Dave takes a deep dive into the lives and strategies of the final six artists with never-before-seen footage from the season.
The artists carry their own weight in a team Flash Challenge, accuracy is tested in a head-to-head portrait Elimination Tattoo, and artist Tim Hendricks is a guest judge.
The artists must work with their teams to transform canvases into cyborgs, and tattooing legend and author Chris Garver is a guest judge.

Kikyo looks for Naraku. She meets Kansuke, an old bandit. Kansuke has a serious illness and is trying to find a place to die.

In a certain village, Inuyasha and the gang are surrounded by villagers who dislike Miroku.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Izumo, who is investigating the secret of the creation of the Sacred Jewel.
Kagome and the others are kidnapped by demons who are using fake Sacred Jewels. Inuyasha and the rest go to save them, but Gyuoh stands in their way.
Naraku's poisonous bugs appear. Sesshomaru goes after them. Meanwhile, Jaken is stung by a poisonous bug and is dying. Rin is left with him.
Kirara disappears. Sango is worried. Shippo deduces Kirara's reasons for disappearing.

Jane has made big plans to celebrate Mateo's first birthday, but things start to fall apart when she learns there might be an issue with her wedding venue.
After moving up the wedding day, Jane and Michael find all their carefully made plans thrown into chaos. To make matters worse, Jane is unhappy with her current graduate thesis.

Jane discovers that Michael was shot and finds herself having to make difficult choices. With Rafael focused on keeping Mateo safe, Anezka, who is pretending to be Petra, "helps" the cops with their investigation.

When Rafael finally admits that he is over Jane, their co-parenting style is tested when they argue over what the best preschool is for Mateo. Xo is paranoid about Alba finding out her secret and what it will do to their relationship.
Jane continues to work on her thesis and she decides to add Alba's estranged sister to the narrative, much to Alba's dismay. Rogelio tries for his chance at being an American crossover star.

Jane and Michael's housewarming party hits a snag when they discover they are being evicted for not paying their rent. Rogelio is still trying to break into American television, but needs some unusual help from Rafael.

Jane convinces Alba to let her read the letters from her estranged sister, but under the condition Jane doesn't reach out to her family. Rafael is starting to suspect that something is different with Petra.

When Jane's cousin unexpectedly shows up at her door, Jane questions her own less than spontaneous life. Xo finds the perfect location for her dance studio, but it happens to be near her ex-boyfriend, Bruce.

When Alba makes Jane feel guilty for not attending church, Jane decides she wants to bring Mateo against Rafael's wishes. Rafael unlocks a long lost memory of his mother, which could be a clue in the Mutter case. Rogelio hires a matchmaker.

Jane finds it difficult to stop meddling in other people's relationships, especially Xo's and Rafael's. Rogelio makes an unorthodox agreement with his matchmaker. Petra goes to great lengths to find out if Rafael is working against her.

Jane and Michael are both feeling the pressure - Jane with turning in the perfect novel and Michael with passing his upcoming test. Rogelio invites everyone to the last day of filming for his telenovela, but he is not pleased with the ending.

When Jane realizes that she and Michael are both stressed out, they decide to recreate their first date to help them relax. Rogelio makes a big scene on the red carpet of his film premiere and his rant goes viral.

Working in publishing is not what Jane thought it would be, until she learns about a showcase for up and coming writers. With Petra helming the Marbella, she decides to rebrand the hotel, but quickly butts heads with the rival hotel next door.

When Jane is offered a book deal, she thinks her prayers have been answered and debates quitting her publishing job. After suffering from panic attacks, Jane is ready to get to the root of the problem. Rogelio and Xo work on fixing their friendship.

When Jane messes up at Mateo's school, Petra convinces Jane to help with the preschool fundraiser to get in the good graces of the preschool's director. Jane is excited for her first meeting with her editor, but it does not go the way she expected.

Jane feels guilty that she isn't around for Mateo as much as she would like, so she decides to run for Room Mom against none other than perfect mom, Petra. Alba tries to impress her crush, but it doesn't go well.

Jane is finally ready to get back in the dating game so she enlists the help of Rafael and Petra, but it seems they have their own issues to work on. Alba takes Xo and Jane's advice about being an independent woman when it comes to Jorge.

With Destiny’s Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn.

With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny’s Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja breaks him out of jail.

The ninja’s search for Nadakhan’s ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan’s crew is struggling to handle an airship that used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya.

Jay reveals to Cole that he made two wishes with Nadakhan. Large chunks of NINJAGO City are disappearing without a trace. The ninja find the Tiger Widow Island on the map but it is an island that exists on no other chart or database.

When the dream chasers discover the eye of confusion's location, it kicks off a treasure hunt with the Never Witch's doppelgangers in hot pursuit.
Logan and Astrid face their fears in the Dream Forge while Mateo, Zoey, and Z-Blob seek out the Gnorfs to destroy the Eye of Confusion.

Cragger tricks Laval into withholding CHI from the Crocodile tribe. This reignites the hostilities between the Lions and Crocodiles. Laval must frantically escape the wrath of the Crocs and somehow get rid of the CHI before his father finds out.

Laval and Eris take a Lion tank for a ride around Chima. But it may not be such a good idea. During their trip, they discover that Cragger has employed a tribe of beavers in an elaborate plot to steal all the Chi.

Each month there is a big market at the Speedor races. Laval and Eris go there, but Cragger has hired the Ravens to steal Laval’s precious Speedor. And suddenly the prize of the races, the Golden Chi, has also disappeared.

The Crocodiles hire the Ravens to trick the Wolves into attacking the Eagle Spires. But it is all part of an elaborate plot to harm both the Lions, Eagles and Wolves. Laval and Eris must act quickly to save the day.
At the night of the Hundred-Year Moon, the Wolves are running wild and causing havoc. Crooler kidnaps a young gorilla girl to lure Laval, Eris and Gorzan the Gorilla out to rescue her.

Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a performance for their friends in the park.
Throughout the day, Barney and the children learn about "hot" and "cold," but the fun really begins when Barney turns the playground into a winter/summer wonderland!

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

programmes.st: This Way In, This Way Out!
programmes.d: Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.

Beth has invented a brand-new holiday called "Happy Day," in which everyone gets to make a wish for something which will make them happy—and everyone else tries to make that wish come true!  Barney and the kids discuss feelings and facial expressions.
The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.

It's the day of the bike parade.  But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd.  Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.

Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them.  And by the end of the day, the kids have learned that big or little, they're all wonderful just the way they are!
Barney and the children have fun playing with and learning about busses and cars.
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive.  Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.
A day of imaginative play and fun for Barney and his young friends is kicked off by the arrival of a variety of boxes from the "Enjoy-Your-Toys Company."  Surprisingly, every box is empty!
Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.
Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can.  It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!
Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last.  She's not having a very good day.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.
After a brief misunderstanding, BJ realizes he has many friends.  He enjoys a day playing with Barney and the children.
The children work together to make a bird house.  They are happy to learn that the bird will have lots of company; many animals make their homes in the park too!

Dolly Parton is the most honoured female country performer of all time. She has had 25 songs reach No1 on the Billboard Country charts, a record for female artists. She has 41 career top 10 country albums, a record for any artist.

After serving two years in the army where Elvis meets fourteen year old Priscilla Beaulieu, he moves her into Graceland while embarking on a disastrous film career.

programmes.d: The 70's were a decade of extremes for The Stones. They rose to the height of their collective creative prowess, spun downward under stardom's weight, then climbed up again.

Things get heated down South, as the A-Listers' true colors come out.
Hey y'all!  The drama continues in Dallas.
The A-Listers discover that someone isn't being completely honest.

programmes.st: Get Out From Under My Boot!

Fresh off the heels of his blowout fight with Phillip, James licks his wounds and tries to navigate the aftermath with his friends.  However, things don't patch up so easily for James: Ashley won't stop texting him, and he is "dead" to Phillip.

Looks like Levi has got his hands full yet again. Combine a needy new boyfriend, an upcoming rodeo competition and Ashley's new charity - it's a wonder he has any free time at all! Will Chase be able to rope Levi into a full-time relationship?

Chase is trying to play it cool but it's obvious he's fallen head over heels for Levi, who still refuses to make their relationship official. Chase decides to take some time apart with the hopes that distance will make Levi's heart grow fonder.

programmes.st: The A-List: Dallas Showdown at the Rodeo
programmes.d: The season may be coming to a close for the A-Listers but the drama definitely continues. Levi is chosen as the face of the gay rodeo and his friends are more than happy to celebrate with him. Especially Chase and Taylor who can't seem to stop fighting!

The A-List: Dallas boys and their gal pal Ashley are back and they're ready to face off for another round of Texas style, over-the-top drama. Wendy Williams returns to host this outrageous reunion special.
