Julie March becomes Ben Matlock’s houseguest at an inopportune time in their relationship. Julie is the prosecuting attorney in a murder case that has Ben defending dance instructor Scott Lazar for the hit-and-run death of his benefactor – and lover.
Matlock runs into a series of high-level roadblocks when he goes to Washington to defend a popular columnist accused of murdering her source.
Matlock finds himself in a legal dilemma: his client stuns the courtroom with a confession, and then, saying that government agents had persuaded her to do so, tries to recant it.
It’s War of The Roses, Freudian style as divorcing psychiatrists forsake their couches for the courtroom. Matlock gets caught in the middle of a brutal battle that bruises more than egos.
Matlock holds the last ray of hope for a veteran circus clown, Homer Fleming, accused of murdering his partner during a performance.
Ben Matlock uncovers plots within a plot when Noel Bishop, the wunderkind director of horror films, is accused of murdering motion picture star Catherine McKay as the cameras roll.
The senseless murder of a toy store owner not only clouds the Christmas spirit, but threatens an annual party and gifts of toys to local orphans.

Disagreeable London-based American businessman Albert Gordon is shot dead. His son Eric is the prime suspect. Believing Eric's innocent, sister Laura plans a mock trial hoping to uncover new evidence. Ben travels to London to defend Eric.
Matlock discovers he has more than enough suspects to go around for a murder which has the wrong man in jail.
It’s good news/bad news for Ben Matlock on the day he will be honored as Atlanta’s Man of the Year.
Matlock goes head-to-head with a millionaire bent on revenge. Ben has to get inside the mind of a diabolical killer to avenge the death of his best friend.

When Matlock’s neighbor, Les Calhoun, returns a malfunctioning used car he just bought, he becomes the prime suspect in the salesman's murder. Although circumstantial evidence points to a conviction, Matlock sets out to prove his new neighbor was framed.

A frame-up finds Matlock immersed in libel, scandal, and tales of alien spaceships! Delving into the lurid world of tabloid publishing, Matlock and his new investigator, Jerri Stone, sort through the world’s weirdest clues to solve a murder.
A deathbed letter from an old friend puts the life of Ben Matlock in peril when he feels morally obligated to reopen a murder case more than three decades old.
An afternoon fishing expedition evolves into a nightmare. Matlock watches in horror as the boat he just disembarked suddenly explodes into a fireball killing his companion, Judge Stern.

A woman arrives home to find her house on fire and her husband dead. The police believe she did it to kill her husband who supposedly was planning on leaving her. A newspaper reporter helps Ben and discovers the husband had a secret past.
Matlock defends a patrolman framed for murder and is upset when he must investigate his longtime friend, the chief of police, as the prime murder suspect.
Guest star Jack Cassidy is Orin Kerr, an ex-hoodlum who now controls the largest gambling resort in the western hemisphere as a front for the underworld crime syndicate.

An F.B.I. man is blinded while investigating a crime syndicate attempting to take over a large chemical plant. Jim Phelps undergoes a delicate eye operation so as to appear convincingly blind when he poses as the sightless man.

An undercover agent is murdered while trying to intercept a huge heroin shipment in the Pacific Northwest and the IMF team is called to take over and put the dealer and his chief executioner out of business.

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
In a battle with organized crime, the IMF sets up a bizarre mind-transfer experiment to convince a syndicate leader he is being double-crossed on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Guest star Bradford Dillman plays Edison, a former private detective turned extortionist who is blackmailing a powerful crime chief with a roll of film linking him to murder.
NATO's missile defense system plans, mapped on two separate overlays for security reasons, are the target of a Central European spy organization.
The resurgence of neo-Nazism in Germany takes the IMF to Bavaria, where Marcus von Frank (Hans Gudegast) threatens to become a second Hitler.
Gangsters running a loan-shark racket in Hawaii short-circuit the IMF team's investigation when they capture Willy and feed him gigantic doses of truth serum.
Guest stars Gerald S. O'Loughlin and Christopher Stone portray crime syndicate bosses in charge of the waterfront who extort huge sums of money from every ship docking at a west coast port.

Ed Nelson guest stars as Van Cleve, a brilliant thief who is convinced by the IMF that he has the power of precognition as part of its plan to recover the more than five million dollars worth of art treasures that he has stolen.
Jim Phelps comes to the aid of a personal friend.
The team must trick a crooked investment promoter into endorsing $80 million in stolen stocks and then getting them back from him.
Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.

Musical comedy star Sally Ann Howes plays a dramatic role as a guest member of the IMF when it sets out to foil a plot to ruin a friendly country with counterfeit money on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

With the threat of another off-shore missile crisis and perhaps a confrontation that could lead to war, the IMF is called upon to expose a nuclear arms treaty secretly signed by a previously friendly country and a hostile power in "The Catafalque"

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

programmes.st: Field Trip to Visit Koko the Gorilla
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

programmes.st: An Eye Exam for Mister Rogers
programmes.d: At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

programmes.st: A Boy and His Service Dog
programmes.d: Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Rides In a Helicopter
programmes.d: Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

programmes.st: Musician Yo-Yo Ma and Inventor Chuck Hoberman
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of inventor Chuck Hoberman with his sphere and a video of Yo-Yo and Nicholas Ma. The neighbors are waiting for Bob Dog's helicopter to land. They discover that the helicopter responds to guitar music.

Mister Rogers visits Maya Lin at her studio to see how she first makes small models of big things she is working on. They go to Penn Station to see what she created there. In Make-Believe, there's a video visit with cellist Yo-Yo Ma.

Mister Rogers sees a performance by the Westminster Bell Choir and shows how people make bells. Mayor Maggie has a bell that she plays with King Friday and gives to Henrietta as a doorbell. Daniel and H.J. Elephant dress up as astronauts.

Visiting a nearby dance studio, Mister Rogers watches a class of young students learning to use ribbons as part of their dance routine. Henrietta is still ringing her new bell and X the Owl is growing quite frustrated.

Percussionist Tim Adams performs. H.J. Elephant is dressed in his outerspace costume as he tells Lady Aberlin about pretending to fly to the moon. He makes a loud trumpet sound which causes alarm for X and Henrietta.

Mister Rogers shows a video of himself and Sylvia Earle snorkeling in the ocean. Lady Elaine says she is hiding from something they are afraid of from outer space. Mister Rogers suggests when something is scary on TV,  turn it off.

Neighbor Aber places a costume on top of Trolley to participate in the upcoming parade. Prince Tuesday is collecting comforting messages for X the Owl and Henrietta Pussycat in hopes of drawing them out for the parade.

programmes.st: The Royal Hula Mouse Must Return

Mister Rogers watches demonstrations of mechanical ball inventions. Prince Tuesday and Lady Aberlin are outside the castle playing with a unique toy. King Friday is unhappy about not finding Hula Mouse and breaks the toy.
Not everyone in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe has recovered from the previous day's drama. King Friday tries to apologize. Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make bread.

Mister Rogers watches children dancers perform and musicians play. King Friday sincerely apologizes to Hula Mouse for his previous behavior. Lady Elaine presents an exhibit of round things. Mr. McFeely shows a film on how marbles are made.

Sharon and the team track an unhinged killer making his own film, with his victims as the stars. A new romance finds wings.
A gun used in a murder is connected to the most troubling series of unsolved homicides in LAPD history. Captain Raydor and the rest of her division attempt to solve the mystery.
Sharon and Major Crimes rush to capitalize on a shocking discovery made in a church. Steph (JULIE ANN EMERY) and Sanchez's connection grows as they bond over lost loved ones.
With another victim found, Sharon focuses on former LAPD detective Mark Hickman (JASON GEDRICK). Fritz (JON TENNEY) and his team help the LAPD show up in force at a funeral.
More information pours in about victims from the past and how they tie to the murders of the present. Lt. Cooper (MALCOM-JAMAL WARNER) and Amy Sykes get caught in a gun fight.
In the gripping season finale, the threads of seven murders are tied together as the video wire on Reverend Price (TARIK LOWE) elicits admissions, narrowing the field of suspects.
In the season premiere, the Major Crimes squad investigates the mysterious disappearance of a teenage girl who vanished while volunteering at a homeless shelter.
Ari (guest start Rudolf Martin) continues to wreak havoc on the NCIS team as he uses its members as pawns in the game he is playing with Gibbs.

Under order from the Governor of Virginia, a skeptical Gibbs is forced to meet with a serial killer he helped to convict a decade before under the pretense that the killer will tell Gibbs where he hid missing bodies.
Gibbs and the team are called in when a recently deceased man is found encased in a Civil War-era tomb. The corpse is that of a missing Staff Sergeant who, according to Ducky, was buried alive.
To get the money to purchase a new VCR that Al won't buy her, Peggy takes a job in a department store selling clocks.
When Al and Peg decide to go on vacation, Steve and Marcy volunteer to take care of their kids, Bud and Kelly. But, their enthusiasm changes when the kids throw a huge party at the Rhoades' house.

Al invites Steve to play poker with his friends but ends up losing his paycheck to Al.  Avoiding telling the truth to Marcy fails as Al plans to use his winnings to buy a fishing rod.  Ultimately, Marcy enlists the help of Peggy to stop him.

When the owner of the shoe store is in a near-fatal plane crash, Al decides that it is time to get some recognition from his boss or quit his job. After quitting, Al returns to the shoe store, but not without a surprise.

Marcy freaks out when she begins having erotic dreams about Al after a heated argument about men vs women, and wonders whether she is actually sexually attracted to Al. Haunted by her dreams, Marcy ultimately comes to a conclusion and confronts Al.

When Berta discovers that Alan has been secretly dating her daughter, Naomi, Alan expects trouble. But Berta's reaction is surprising—and much worse—than Alan could have imagined.

When Adam discovers that the pastor he hired for their wedding was a phony and he and Andi aren't really married, he scrambles to find a way to fix it before she finds out.
When the kids won't do their chores, Adam and Andi decide to go on strike too.
When Adam thinks Kate's boyfriend, Tyler (Griffin Gluck), is a pothead, he decides to confront Tyler but doesn't get the support he expects from Andi.
When Adam needs to hire a new project manager, Andi accuses Adam of unconscious bias after he only interviews men for the job.
Adam and Andi try to get back in their neighbors' good graces after no one shows up to their potluck.
When Adam and Andi are caught off guard by unexpected expenses, they each decide to give up a luxury to pay them off.
When Adam takes his kids to work with him for the day, they accidentally give his biggest client lice. Also, Andi feels like a bad mom when she's the only one in the family not to get lice.
When Adam notices his Dad's increasingly forgetful behavior, he struggles with how to approach him to discuss it.
When Adam and Andi agree on a present-free Valentine's Day, Adam gives the gift he planned for Andi to his mother instead.

Doug doesn't want to go to the opera.

programmes.st: Wake Up! The Color of Observation Able to Top the Strongest!
programmes.d: Luffy leans on his training to bring out the power of his Haki! Meanwhile, the children of Big Mom gather as a massive force, ready to smash Luffy and the Straw Hats. Their resentment at being embarrassed fuels their desire to get revenge!

programmes.st: A Fist of Divine Speed! Another Gear Four Application Activated!
programmes.d: Luffy and Katakuri are locked in a duel to end all duels! Their powers ensure that each blow could be the last! Luffy must rely on his training, let all his thoughts out, and keep pushing on! Meanwhile, Sanji is about to land at Cacao Island!

programmes.st: Finally, It's Over! The Climax of the Intense Fight against Katakuri!
programmes.d: Luffy's dramatic battle finally draws to a close! But even if he is able to pull out victory in the last moment, can he remember the key to escaping the Mirrorworld?!

programmes.st: A Desperate Situation! The Iron-tight Entrapment of Luffy!
programmes.d: Luffy emerges safely! And Pekoms' bravery ensures he and the Straw Hats have a fighting chance! But can they withstand the full force of the Big Mom Pirates? At the last moment - a surprise explodes onto the scene!

programmes.st: Pulling Back from the Brink! The Formidable Reinforcements – Germa!
programmes.d: Sanji tries his best to save himself and his captain, Luffy! But the arrival of Germa has complicated matters. Whose side do these powerful superhumans fight on? In the end, sisterly love will see Sanji saved!

programmes.st: The Last Hope! The Sun Pirates Emerge!
programmes.d: Luffy and Sanji are safe! But the critical moment approaches - the fate of Totto Land rests on the taste of the wedding cake! Will it be sweet release or bitter defeat? Meanwhile, a cunning pincer attack leaves the Straw Hats hopelessly trapped.

programmes.st: A Captivating Flavor! Sanji's Cake of Happiness!
programmes.d: With the help of the Sun Pirates, the Straw Hats see their chance to escape! And the Sun Pirates bid farewell to their former captain. Mama finally tastes the Wedding Cake and the results are positively scrumptious!

programmes.st: The Man of Humanity and Justice! Jimbei, a Desperate Massive Ocean Current!
programmes.d: The Big Mom Pirates fooled! The Straw Hats have eluded their would-be tormentors with the help of the Sun Pirates! However, as the fleet of the Big Mom Pirates is still coming after them, Jimbei makes a crucial decision to help the Sunny to get away.

programmes.st: The Parting Time! Pudding's Last Wish!
programmes.d: At a great cost of energy and life, the Straw Hats make it out of Totto Land. Left behind in their wake are allies and friends, and would-be lovers. As the sea opens before them, what price has been paid for their escape?

programmes.st: The World is Stunned! The Fifth Emperor of the Sea Emerges!
programmes.d: Luffy's recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats' next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!

programmes.st: To the Reverie! The Straw Hats' Sworn Allies Come Together!
programmes.d: As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don't fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy's exploits and remembers their shared past.

programmes.st: Sabo Goes into Action! All the Captains of the Revolutionary Army Appear!
programmes.d: A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard's affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help.

programmes.st: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
programmes.d: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

programmes.st: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
programmes.d: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.

programmes.st: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
programmes.d: Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.

programmes.st: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!
programmes.d: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

programmes.st: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
programmes.d: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

programmes.st: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
programmes.d: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.

programmes.st: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!

programmes.st: Climbing Up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!

programmes.st: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido's Army!
programmes.d: Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!

programmes.st: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
programmes.d: Otama's gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!

programmes.st: Side Story! The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
programmes.d: Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre's group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny's Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution.

programmes.st: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
programmes.d: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

programmes.st: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding through the Wasteland!
programmes.d: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido's underlings show up too!

programmes.st: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
programmes.d: Otama's temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido's Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.

After a man is found brutally murdered inside his own bar, a murder mystery unfolds over the span of years; detectives believe it's a business deal gone bad and must remain steadfastly dedicated to the case after hitting several dead ends.
In the summer of 1991, a pair of half-siblings creates panic across southern California when they embark on a spree of random crimes of the worst kind, targeting people out doing everyday tasks.

Over a brutal 7-month stretch, a trio of brothers commit a series of increasingly violent crimes across the city of Richmond, leaving behind a growing body count; even after their apprehension, these brothers prove difficult to contain.

A pair of larger-than-life identical twins commit a series of brutal attacks in a small Tennessee town; with each crime, the brothers grow more emboldened; as time goes on and with little evidence against them, there's no telling how far they'll go.

When a correctional officer is murdered, it seems like an act of vengeance, but a love triangle is exposed; after learning his wife is having an affair, a husband plans to kill her lover and enlists the help of his brothers to carry out the task.

A missing persons case spirals down a winding path once detectives learn that a formerly beloved older brother appears to have embezzled money from the family's business; his siblings are hellbent on getting revenge.

In one of the most tragic and brutal crimes in the history of the Great Plains, five teens playing by a campfire are ambushed by a trio of shotgun-wielding brothers; a lone survivor bravely helps detectives hunt down her assailants.
An immigrant family's American dream turns into a nightmare when a devious sister manipulates her younger valedictorian brother into committing murder; a dark family secret comes to light.
In this bizarre Midwestern saga; a grudge between a shady district attorney and an eccentric local student turns deadly; investigators work for decades to bring a quartet of brothers to justice.

When a body is found badly burned outside of Chicago, police work tirelessly to track down the killer of this young, hardworking truck driver; the search leads them to an unlikely pair of teenage sisters who are able to evade capture for years.
When the patrons of a rural bar are murdered execution-style, two determined detectives work to track down a pair of killer brothers and solve the most heinous crime in the history of the small town.

Two brothers pull off an elaborate scheme in the desert to rob an armored van of $300,000; when investigators attempt to track down the illusive robbers, the case becomes a homicide once the bodies of the two guards driving the van turn up.
In the fall of 1992, two brothers terrorize a California community when they embark on a two-month crime spree that includes three brutal murders and many more near-death attacks.

Residents of quiet Noel, Mo., are shocked when the local bank is robbed in a brazen nighttime heist; the investigation takes a sinister turn when the bank's president is found dead and a pair of brothers suddenly come into a lot of cash.

Things get murky along the Tennessee River when a mussel distributor and his fiancée are killed by a trio of roughneck brothers who are determined to steal a big payout and silence anyone who gets in their way.

The ambitious Luna brothers take wildly divergent paths, one becoming a decorated army officer while another rises in a Mexican cartel; when the brothers' worlds collide, a murder ultimately brings them down.

Tragedy strikes rural Iowa as two women are found murdered in their homes; when a local bank is robbed the same day, investigators connect the crimes to an unfolding crime spree and race to find the killer siblings before they can strike again.

A peaceful town is rocked by the murder of the young wife of a preacher's son; the investigation leads detectives to two brothers: one with a deadly ambition, and the other willing to do anything to earn his brother's love.

When the body of a young woman is found in a burnt out station wagon, investigators unravel a deadly plot that leads back to a shattered marriage and two self-made millionaire brothers who feel entitled to do anything to anyone.

The history of the Hubble Telescope, as told by the brilliant minds and mavericks who built and repaired it.

Two massive prehistoric monsters are better than one, so Cyril travels to the dangerous swamps and wild coast of Louisiana to track down a pair of predators that hunt its murky waters.

Cyril has come to the remote jungle rivers of Nicaragua on a mission to catch one of the most explosive fish on the planet. Weighing over 300 pounds and measuring 8 feet long, the tarpon is a real primitive titan.

Growing to over 1400 lbs, the blue fin tuna is a true titan prowling the oceans, and it's extremely powerful and fast. To help protect these endangered giants, Cyril is recruited by a team of biologists to travel up the East Coast of the USA and Canada.

Yossi's friend Kato brings in a prop from the "Green Hornet" TV series; Yossi and Dominique visit the home of shoe designer Taryn Rose; an item that belonged to Bette Davis; NBA player Luke Walton visits the shop.

Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!
Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer.  They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

The Enterprise's command crew must thwart an invasion by aliens from another galaxy who plan to conquer this one.
The Enterprise finds a planet devastated by disease that appears to treat the American flag with great reverence.
Starfleet uses the Enterprise to test a new super-sophisticated computer, but it soon develops a mind of its own.
The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.
Kirk must decide whether to thwart or help a traveller from the future sent back to 1960s Earth on a secret mission.
The crew of the Enterprise pursues a mysterious woman who has abducted Spock's brain.
Captain Kirk becomes increasingly erratic and orders the Enterprise into Romulan space. Here, the ship is captured by a beautiful Romulan commander.
Kirk loses his memory and is proclaimed a God while trapped on a planet whose inhabitants are descended from Northwestern Native Americans.
The Enterprise reaches a Federation colony where the adults have all killed themselves but the children play without care.

programmes.st: Is There In Truth No Beauty?

When coming to a xenophobic isolationist planet, Captain Kirk and his landing party are punished for trespassing.
When the Enterprise brings aboard Klingon prisoners, an alien entity pits both sides against each other in an ever-escalating struggle.

programmes.st: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
programmes.d: At the same time McCoy discovers that he has a year to live, the U.S.S. Enterprise encounters the asteroid Yonada which is determined to be artificially propelled.
Kirk is trapped in interphase, while the Enterprise is trapped by a powerful energy web.
After Dr. McCoy helps the leader of a planet populated by people with powerful psionic abilities, they decide to force him to stay by torturing his comrades until he submits.
Hyper-accelerated aliens, invisible to the naked eye, take over the Enterprise.
Odo's mentor arrives on Deep Space Nine intent on resuming his search for Odo's true origin.
Bashir and O'Brien work to rid two alien races of deadly weapons, unaware that their hosts intend to sacrifice them as part of the peace process.
O'Brien returns from a security mission to notice that the entire crew has seemingly turned against him.
Sisko and O'Brien are stranded on a planet inhabited by humans who have rejected any form of technology.
Odo and Dax try to solve the mystery of an alien planet whose inhabitants are disappearing without explanation.
While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.
When Quark is reunited with the love of his life, a Cardassian who is now a fugitive, he is ready to sacrifice everything to win her back.
Dax risks her life and her future with Starfleet to fulfill a blood oath made with three aged Klingons.
Sisko uncovers a Federation terrorist group whose actions could start another war with the Cardassians.
Sisko and Gul Dukat join forces in an effort to avert a war between the Cardassians and a group of Federation colonists led by Sisko's old friend.
Bashir fights to save his Cardassian friend Garak, who is slowly being killed by a brain implant to which he is addicted.
A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.
Kira must investigate the man she loves when she learns he may be the Cardassian collaborator responsible for the massacre of forty-three Bajorans.
O'Brien is arrested by the Cardassians and put on trial for a crime he insists he did not commit.
During a trip to the Gamma Quadrant with Jake and Nog, Sisko and Quark are imprisoned by soldiers working for a mysterious power known as the Dominion.
Hoping to avert an invasion, Sisko takes his officers into the Gamma Quadrant to find the leaders of the Dominion
While Odo struggles to learn the ways of his people, Sisko discovers that the price of peace with the Dominion may be too high.

In attempting to aid the damaged Earth freighter Fortunate, the Enterprise finds itself caught in the middle of a cold-blooded revenge plot. Mayweather uses his past to ultimately resolve the heated conflict

While the Enterprise witnesses a religious stellar occurrence, Archer finds himself again faced against the Suliban warrior Silik, while allied with a Temporal soldier from the future sent to prevent Silik from changing the course of history.
Faced with defending themselves against a powerful, unidentified alien vessel, Trip and Reed frantically work to install the massive phase cannons into the Enterprise before the vessel returns.

After discovering that an alien race is slowly becoming extinct due to a genetic disease, Archer and Dr. Phlox struggle with the decision of whether to interfere by saving the species or to let nature make its own choices.
While investigating a strange Klingon vessel, T'Pol, Reed and Hoshi become stranded when a Klingon female escapes the disabled ship in their shuttlepod.
T'Pol is blamed for the Andorian destruction of the sanctuary of P'Jem, and is therefore removed of her position onboard the Enterprise.

After returning to where they left the Enterprise and finding only the scattered remains of their ship, Trip and Reed struggle to survive and hope for rescue with only a few days worth of oxygen left inside Shuttlepod One.
Encountering a group of Vulcan pilgrims on a mission to explore their emotions, T'Pol is enticed to attempt some of their technique with a handsome and charming pilgrim, Tolaris.
Archer and his crew encounter a group of alien hunters upon a rogue planet that has broken out of its orbit.
The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.
Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.
Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.
Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.
Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.
Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.
The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

programmes.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programmes.d: 23rd century: The Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

programmes.t: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programmes.d: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the planet Genesis are empty victories. Spock is dead, and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

programmes.t: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programmes.d: It’s the 23rd century, and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

programmes.t: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programmes.d: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

programmes.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programmes.d: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon Empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when an apparent attack from the Enterprise nearly destroys a Klingon ship.  Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

programmes.t: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
programmes.d: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

programmes.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

When a female crew member is infatuated with Lieutenant Commander Data, he decides to give a romantic relationship a try. Also, the Enterprise finds itself having to maneuver through a dangerous nebula.
Both Capt. Picard and Lt. Worf must decide where their priorities lie as the Klingon Empire descends into civil war.
Picard risks all-out war with the Romulans when he involves Starfleet in a Klingon civil war.
The crew is rendered helpless when Picard is kidnapped and forced to go to war with an alien captain.
Picard suspects a high-level Federation conspiracy when the crew is ordered to locate the terrorist leader of a renegade race.
Picard struggles to communicate with a mysterious, destructive force before a visiting scientist can destroy it.
The lives of the crew are in Troi's hands when a natural disaster forces her to take over as captain of the seriously damaged Enterprise.
The fate of the Federation is in Wesley Crusher's hands when he returns to find the crew of the Enterprise addicted to a dangerous new game.
Picard and Mr. Spock clash over a proposed reunification of the Romulans and the Vulcans.
Picard and Data travel to investigate an unauthorized mission undertaken by the Federation's legendary Mr. Spock.
Picard's quest to save an endangered planet leads him to violate a Prime Directive when he seeks advice from a visitor from the future.
Worf learns some painful lessons about parenting when his son Alexander arrives to join his father on the Enterprise.
A young boy who is the sole survivor of a devastated ship becomes obsessed with simulating Data.
Troi, Riker and Dr. Crusher fall into unexplained comas while the Enterprise plays host to an alien race.
Picard's efforts to save a genetically engineered society from a natural disaster threaten to destroy it.
While suffering an unexplained case of amnesia, the crew finds themselves fighting a war they do not remember or understand.
Inhabited by alien spirits, Data and Troi overthrow the Bridge of the Enterprise.
The ship is surrounded by creatures whose presence accelerates Kes' reproductive process and threatens Voyager's key operating systems.
Ensign Harry Kim awakens on Earth, where he's shocked to learn there's no record of his assignment on Voyager.
A strange spatial distortion afflicts the ship and has the entire crew literally lost on their own ship.
Neelix and Paris must put aside their romantic rivalry over Kes after they crash-land on a toxic planet.
A mysterious force puts the crew in a delusional state that causes their most deeply buried thoughts and desires to surface.
Chakotay is stranded on a planet inhabited by natives with ties to his ancestors.
Kes makes contact with Ocampa spacefarers and the female Caretaker, who may have the power to send the crew home.
The theft of a transporter module by Kazon forces thrusts Chakotay into an explosive confrontation with his traitorous former lover Seska.
Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.
After Torres reactivates a humanoid robot, she's drawn into a war between robotic enemies.
Hoping to strengthen Voyager's strategic position in the quadrant, Janeway reluctantly seeks an alliance with the Kazon.
Paris makes history by becoming the first person to cross the transwarp threshold, but could pay for the achievement with his life.
Unable to come up with a logical motive for a shipboard murder, Tuvok performs a mind-meld with the perpetrator that brings out Tuvok's "killer instinct."
Torres races against time to stop a deadly self-guided missile on a collision course with disaster.
A rebel Q escapes from incarceration and demands asylum on Voyager so he can commit suicide.
The Doctor falls in love with a Vidiian woman stricken by the deadly Phage.
Neelix helps smoke out the crewmember who has been passing Federation secrets to the Kazon.

Summoned to a planet by a communication code, the team is ambushed by Kolya, who has now created his own faction of Genii after being forced from the inner circle. While the rest of the team manages to escape, Sheppard is taken prisoner.

McKay is called back to earth to convince his estranged sister, Jeannie Miller, to assist the Air Force. McKay and Jeannie travel to Atlantis and begin the experiment which is initially successful until a McKay from the parallel universe appears.

Major Leonard's team fails to check in with Atlantis while on a mission. Following the energy readings in hope of finding Major Leonard and his men, McKay leads the team into a cave to discover that the cause the energy spike is a Wraith generator.

The now awakened Ancients meet with O'Neill and Woolsey, thanking them for taking care of the city but also asking them to vacate Atlantis. While Ronon and Teyla stay in the Pegasus galaxy, the rest struggle to resume their lives on Earth.

O'Neill and Woolsey, the lone survivors of the replicators' bloody coup, hide out in an abandoned section of the city. Knowing Landry has an order to nuke Atlantis if a foothold situation should ever arise, the two lay low awaiting their fate.

Teyla begins to see apparitions of ancients in distress and believes they are the ghosts of the Ancients recently massacred by the Replicators. McKay believes he's found the whale that saved him a year ago while trapped in a submerged puddle jumper.

Dwindling supplies, tedious routines, and low morale continue to plague the crew of the Destiny when the ship suddenly drops out of FTL and enters the orbit of an uncharted star. But, for the first time, the countdown clock doesn’t activate!

Disregarding orders, Dr. Rush links himself to the Destiny’s computer via the neural interface chair, hoping it will reveal the code needed to control Destiny’s flight path. Learning of this, Col. Young struggles with letting Rush risk his life.

Trapped beneath ruins in an underground maze, some of the Destiny's crew are stranded when the ship jumps back into FTL. The situation grows even more desperate when Rush (Robert Carlyle) learns that Destiny will soon be leaving the galaxy!

With crew members stranded, Destiny continues to cross from the present galaxy into the next one. Unable to alter the Destiny's course, Dr. Rush calculates the Destiny will fall short of making it to the next galaxy, stranding them indefinitely.

Hidden in the ruined temple on Dakara is an Ancient weapon powerful enough to destroy the Replicators. Thanks to a timely warning, the team knows it. And thanks to Daniel's repressed Ancient knowledge, Replicator Carter knows it as well.

With a climactic battle behind them, the team turns towards personal matters. Unbeknownst to them, Anubis prepares one final attempt! Meanwhile, Jackson awakens in a way station between the living world and the world of beings that have ascended.

Jackson receives documents that point to the location of a ZPM in ancient Egypt. Hoping that the energy source could be used to power Earth's defenses and open a wormhole to Atlantis, SG-1 uses an ancient time machine to travel back to 3000 B.C.

SG-1's attempt to recover a ZPM from 3000 B.C. has altered the timeline, leading to a present where the Stargate was never discovered! The alternate-reality Carter and Jackson convince a reluctant O'Neill to take them on their first mission through.

Lieutenant Colonel Cameron Mitchell, the newest member of the SG-1 team, sets out on a mission with Daniel Jackson, Teal'c and Vala to uncover a stash of hidden ancient riches. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Still bound together by the Jaffa bracelets, Daniel Jackson and Vala are transported to a galaxy populated by worshippers of a potentially threatening authority called the Ori. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Daniel and Vala learn that their reactivation of an ancient communications device has inadvertently exposed Earth to the wrath of the group of unforgiving deities called Ori. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions.  Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business.  The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career.  However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programmes.st: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programmes.d: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez.  Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home.  Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic.  Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.
Mark runs away from home after his father questions his story about overhearing a plot to rob the bank.
A famous buffalo hunter tries to goad Lucas into a shooting match. When Lucas refuses, he becomes the new target.
When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.
Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.
Lucas is drawn to a young widow passing through town on her way to claim an inheritance but others who covet it are trying to kill her.
After a young stablehand kills a notorious gunslinger, he is baffled by the hostility of the townspeople about giving him the reward.
When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer. The plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A condemned killer being transported by train murders a marshal and takes Mark hostage.
Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.
Lucas and Marshall Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded young soldier who deserted.
After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother he no longer seems interested in getting well.
An old friend of Lucas's returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.
After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.
Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.
Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.
Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programmes.st: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programmes.d: Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policeman try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.
Paul Radin has invited three people to join him in his bomb shelter.

programmes.st: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programmes.d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programmes.st: The Last Night of a Jockey
programmes.d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.
A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.
After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.
A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.
A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.
A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her, and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…
Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.
A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!
Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.
Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.
A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.
A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.
A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programmes.st: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programmes.d: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.
Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!
Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!
The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."
On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon employ the services of a man who possesses a power of concentration that controls animals.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Flying Pie Plate
programmes.d: Agent West gets involved in a bizarre extortion scheme involving green "Venusians" who claim they need gold for spaceship fuel.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Poisonous Posey
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon visit a town named Justice during Law and Order Seek and find it the site for a convention of criminals.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Bottomless Pit
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon are assigned to free a fellow agent from Devil's Island.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Watery Death
programmes.d: Secret agent West is kidnapped by a madman who plans to create an underwater kingdom that will control the world's shipping lanes.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Green Terror
programmes.d: The evil, diminutive Dr. Loveless impoverishes an Indian tribe so that he can become their benefactor -- and their god.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Ready Made Corpse
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon fail to save the life of a highly unpopular Latin American dictator they have been assigned to guard.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Man-Eating House
programmes.d: Agent Gordon has a vivid nightmare about a prisoner's mother's ghost who attempts to clear the name of her son, imprisoned 35 years.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Infernal Machine
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon seek the reason why the life of a federal judge is being threatened.
James West is tried by a court of cutthroats who believe he has murdered his friend and fellow agent, Artemus Gordon.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Lord Of The Limbo
programmes.d: Secret agents West and Gordon tangle with an ex-confederate colonel who possesses the power to control the fourth dimension.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Tattering Tontine
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon are assigned to guard a member of an investment group set up so the surviving member will gain all the assets.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Feathered Fury
programmes.d: Secret agents West and Gordon encounter an old adversary who has found the secret of turning objects into gold.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Gypsy Peril
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon are assigned to escort the Sultan of Ramapurand his sacred white elephant, a gift to President Grant.
The receipt of a newspaper that predicts the death, in their presence, of a famed magician, puzzles agents West and Gordon.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Vicious Valentine
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon encounter a society lady who plans to change the U.S.A. into a monarchy and reign as its queen.
A series of deaths are linked to the house from The Brady Bunch.

Mulder escapes from his military cell and embarks on a journey to find the man who can help.

A body is found in the woods, left by a creature as described by witnesses.
Mulder and Scully are sent to investigate the murder of a city official.
Mulder and Scully communicate with a bomber in order to prevent an attack.

The truth is closer than ever.

The frightened parents of a missing boy seek revenge.
Doherty's fascination with his new motorcycle ends badly.

Jack and Janet find a new roommate after Cindy moves off to dormitory life at nearby UCLA. She's Terri Alden, an emergency room nurse who starts off on the wrong foot with Jack in this sixth-season opener.
Larry has made his choice for a new roommate and Jack and Larry begin devising a plan to get rid of Terri.
Jack challenges a famous food critic to sample his cuisine, aiming for a favorable review in his newspaper column.
Janet invites an attractive man to the apartment, expecting that they will be alone, but to her surprise, she finds Jack and Chrissy in the bedroom.
Jack has guilt feelings about not standing up to the tough guy who makes a play for Chrissy at the local pub and goes back the next night to tell the Casanova off.
Roper's on a rampage for the rent so Jack's visiting uncle, a charming rascal, passes him a bad check.
While Stanley Roper is selling the apartment building as a wedding anniversary surprise, his wife catches him with the attractive real estate agent and believes her marriage is breaking up.
Larry devises an acid test to see if Furley's latest find is actually a gold-digger.
Instead of catching sleep in the dingy apartment above his restaurant, Jack catches Mr. Angelino with a young woman.
Jack panics when he suspects Terri's friend wants to give up her life as a nun and marry him.

Terri is up for a promotion and tells Dr. Kenderson she is married to ward off his advances. When he invites himself and his wife over for dinner, Jack poses as Terri's husband while Janet and Larry pose as French-speaking house guests.
The women in Jack's life go to a nude beach protest and run into trouble with the cops.
Chrissy gets a new job selling cosmetics door-to-door, and unexpectedly finds herself in Ralph Furley's winner-take-all strip poker game.
Janet fumes when she inadvertently fixes up Terri with a guy she wanted to date herself.
Terri is making plans for her wedding to a soap opera star - until Jack discovers that his sleazy reputation is well-earned.
An older woman adopts Jack as her surrogate son and smothers him with motherly love.

Jack meets an attractive stewardess, Vicky Bradford; but between her father and her dates, she doesn't seem to have time for Jack. Janet announces her engagement to Philip, while Jack is jealous and lovesick.
A plainclothes cop moves in to protect Jack whose life is in danger after witnessing an armed robbery at the flower shop.
Janet's dinner date with an important, but lecherous, man from the home office turns into a disaster when her "chaperone," Jack, gets drunk and falls asleep in her bed.
Curious landlord Stanley Roper sneaks a peek at an X-rated diary Chrissy is typing and suddenly gets the idea that Chrissy is in love with him.
Chrissy's visiting mother, not knowing that the girls have rented the spare room to Jack, causes havoc when she decides to spend the night with them.
A fault-finding efficiency expert drives Janet to quit her job at the flower shop.
Jack's first day behind the grill at a diner heats up hilariously when his attractive boss tries to spice up her life. Guest Star(s): Ellen Travolta
Jack's attempted romance with Felipe's beautiful cousin, Maria, is plagued by problems - Janet, Terri, Maria's inability to speak English, and Maria's fiancé.

programmes.st: Two Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
programmes.d: Jack and Janet mistake Terri's psychiatric friend for an escapee from a hospital psychiatric ward.
Jack, realizing he can't meet his obligations to pay his share of the rent, gets a part-time modeling job only to find out that he's expected to pose nude. Guest Star(s): Sally Kirkland
75-year-young veteran actor J.Pat O'Malley takes a lesson from the "youngsters" by forming his own "oldster-trio" in a geriatric apartment commune.
Larry's sly suggestion that he and Jack trade apartments after Jack has a tiff with the girls gives lustful Larry the chance to really put the move on Janet and Cindy.
Chrissy cranks out amateur movies of Jack and Janet, and is misled into thinking she has an "interesting" talent for film making.
Jack, Janet, and Chrissy throw a lavish party to help their landlord snare a luscious blonde.
Jack pretends he's a doctor to impress his visiting grandfather, who's eager to observe Jack's hospital practice.

After a night on the town with his old navy buddies, Jack discovers he has a tattoo on his derriere. When Jack goes to the hospital to have it removed, Janet thinks he is having a vasectomy and Furley thinks he is having a sex change.

programmes.t: Jorge Arce vs Wilfredo Vazquez Jr.
programmes.d: On May 7th, 2011, Jorge Arce fought Wilfredo Vazquez Jr for the WBO Super Bantamweight Title at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. In a very close fight that might have been a draw, Vazquez Jr's corner controversially threw in the towel in the final round.

programmes.t: Jose Luis Castillo vs. Stevie Johnston 1
programmes.d: On June 17th, 2000, Jose Luis Castillo fought Stevie Johnston for the WBC Lightweight Title in Bell Gardens, California. In a very close fight, Castillo took the world by surprise with a majority decision victory that was The Ring Upset of the Year.

On March 17th, 2018 Jose Ramirez fought Amir Imam for the vacant WBC World Super Lightweight title at Madison Square Garden Hulu Theater in New York with the twelve-round bout ending in a unanimous decision win for Ramirez.

On September 14th, 2018 Jose Ramirez faced Antonio Orozco for the WBC World Super Lightweight title at the Save Mart Arena in Fresno, Ca. with Orozco suffering legal eye cuts in round 4 and 6 Ramirez was able to secure the unanimous decision victory.

On February 10th, 2019 Jose Ramirez battles Jose Zepeda for the WBC World Super Lightweight title at the Save Mart Arena in Fresno, Ca. with the 12 round bout ending in a majority decision win for Ramirez.

On October 3rd, 2020 Jose Zepeda faced Ivan Baranchyk in a battle for WBC silver super light weight title at the Bubble at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas with both opponents going down it ended in a victory for Zepeda.

On May 22nd, 2021, Josh Taylor fought Jose Ramirez for the undisputed super lightweight title in Las Vegas. With a lot of bad blood going into the fight, Josh Taylor prevailed, winning by a close unanimous decision victory.

programmes.t: Juan Manuel Marquez vs Manny Pacquiao 4
programmes.d: On December 8th, 2012, Manny Pacquiao and Juan Manuel Marquez fought for their fourth and final fight. The bout ended in a stunning knockout victory for Marquez, solidifying their rivalry as one of the most memorable in boxing history.

programmes.t: Juan Manuel Marquez vs Mike Alvarado
programmes.d: On May 17th, 2014, Juan Manuel Marquez fought Mike Alvarado in a WBO Welterweight Title eliminator at The Forum in Inglewood. Both fighters scored a knockdown in the bout, but it was Marquez that prevailed with a unanimous decision victory.

programmes.t: Julio Cesar Chavez vs Ivan Robinson
programmes.d: On May 28th, 2005 Julio Cesar Chavez and Ivan Robinson faced eachother at the Staples Center in Los Angeles resulting in an unamimous decision victory for Julio Cesar Chavez.

programmes.t: Julio Cesar Chavez vs Ken Sigurani
programmes.d: On June 25th, 1998 Julio Cesar Chavez faced Ken Sigurani at the Foxwoods Resort in Mashantucket resulting in a technical knock out win for Julio Cesar Chavez.

programmes.t: Julio Cesar Chavez vs Scott Walker
programmes.d: On February 9th, 1996 Julio Cesar Chavez and Scott Walker faced each other in a 10 round bout at the Cesars Palace Sports Pavilion in Las Vegas that ended in the second round by technical knockout for Julio Cesar Chavez.
On February 16th, 2008 Kelly Pavlik faced Jermain Taylor for a second time at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas the 12 round bout resulted in a unanimous decision win for Pavlik.

On March 31st, 1973 Ken Norton faced Muhammad Ali at the Sports Arena in San Diego for North American Boxing Federation Heavyweight titles in this 12 round bout Ali suffered a broken jaw and Norton scored a victory over The Greatest.

On April 30th, 2022, Keyshawn Davis fought Esteban Sanchez in a lightweight bout at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Delivering a sixth round TKO, Davis showed his speed and agility and that he'll have a promising future in the lightweight division.
On December 11th, 2021, Keyshawn Davis and Jose Zaragoza fought at Madison Square Garden in New York resulting in Zaragoza going down twice in round two giving the victory to Keyshawn Davis.

programmes.t: Keyshawn Davis vs Omar Tienda Bahena
programmes.d: On September 23rd, 2022 Keyshawn Davis fought Omar Tienda Bahena at the Prudential Center in Newark, NJ with Bahena going down in round 5 that solidfied Davis' win by technical knockout.

On February 15th, 1978 Leon Spinks fought Muhammad Ali for WBA & WBC World Heavyweight titles although Spinks defeated Ali he was stripped of the WBC title as he chose to fight The Greatest, Muhammad Ali instead of the #1 contender Ken Norton.

Shelby the Swampman uses an airboat to search for a treasure trove of century old logs in a legendary lost canal. In Washington, Rygaard tries to haul out the biggest log on their site, a mammoth six-ton cypress.

In Louisiana, Shelby looks to repair his custom made two-ton swamp buggy. In Alaska, Coatsy returns to the Papac worksite. In the Pacific Northwest, the Rygaard crew must climb over a hundred feet in the air to top a new lift tree.

Revisit some of your favorite moments from past seasons, and find out what happened to these former 'Zillas when the cameras left and reality really began! Who is still together... and who is headed for divorce court?

New blood boils over as Natalie is fuming over Drita talking behind her back at Renee's fashion show. Tensions run high as the fiery South Philly beauty confronts Drita and doesn't back down.

Alicia looks for answers after discovering her husband Eddie's betrayal on his federal surveillance tapes. Renee brings a new man out to meet the girls but an ill-advised comment by Natalie sends her into a rage.

Tension between Renee and Natalie continues to grow while Drita's new domestic life isn't quite as blissful as she imagined. The women decide a getaway to Las Vegas is the perfect remedy for all their troubles.

The girls start their first morning in Las Vegas trying to get Natalie and Renee to reconcile their issues. Amidst all the tension, Drita heads down to the casino to try and win back some of the thousands of dollars she lost.

The women decide to make the most of their last night in Vegas by going to a strip club. When they get back home, Drita has to come clean to Lee about the $8000 she lost and Alicia has to face the reality of Eddie's sentencing.

Rob talks Laura into leaving their sick son with a babysitter while they go to a party.
Laura dyes her hair blonde when she fears the romance in her marriage is fading.
Laura matches her cousin Thomas with Rob's co-writer, Sally, for a dinner party.

While rummaging through Rob's old Army equipment, Rob and Laura recall how he broke her foot.
Rob invites an old Army pal home to dinner but begins to fear he has a jewel thief on his hands.
Laura begins to worry when Rob has to work nights with a beautiful television star.
Complications ensue when Mel tells Rob that he wants Laura to dance on "The Alan Brady Show."
Rob reluctantly agrees to take care of Buddy's dog for the weekend.
Rob fears he is no longer needed when his co-writers do a show without his help.
Rob invites 44 fellow PTA members to his television show, but forgets all about it until air time.
Laura is afraid to tell Rob that she doesn't like a necklace.
Rob is accused of being a Don Juan when he takes his wife's advice.
Buddy leaves the show for a new job that goes sour.
Six-year-old Ritchie asks his parents about the birds and the bees.
Unable to control her curiosity, Laura opens Rob's mail and she instantly regrets it.
Rob's pal Jerry strains their friendship when he starts knocking Rob's television show in public.
For Rob, a forgotten loan turns into a forgotten debt and a television script.
Rob finds himself besieged by the parents of neighborhood prodigies.
Ritchie's expanding vocabulary starts to branch out in unexpected directions.
While his wife is away, Buddy moves in with the Petries and quickly wears out his welcome.
Rob's paternal pride suffers a cruel shock when he finds out his 6-year-old son is ashamed of him.
Sally drags the entire production staff to a bowling alley, where she unveils a new dance and song.
Laura believes Rob, on jury duty, has been unfairly swayed by the beautiful blonde defendant.
Romance enters Sally's life in the form of an insurance salesman named Leo Fassbinder.
Rob's shy brother (Jerry Van Dyke) has confidence while sleepwalking.
Rob's brother (Jerry Van Dyke) auditions for the show while awake.
Buddy laments the decline of the American male and yearns for the "good old days."
A dinner for Rob's sponsor and his wife is enlivened by the arrival of one of Rob's Army buddies.
Rob tries to help an old radio comedy writer make a comeback.
One of Ritchie's pet ducks dies.
To prove that a wife cannot recognize her husband on the phone, Rob calls Laura for a date.
Rob recalls his and Laura's attempts to get married when Ritchie brings up the subject.
Rob is puzzled when he discovers Laura's secret bank account.
A hypnotist visits a Petrie dinner party where Rob accidentally picks up a post-hypnotic suggestion.
Rob has some explaining to do when son Ritchie learns that his middle name is Rosebud.
A balladeer brings romance into television comedy writer Sally Rogers' life.
A tiring day causes a spat between the Petries.
Rob suspects co-writers Buddy and Sally of carrying on a clandestine romance.
Ritchie claims he keeps being attacked by a giant woodpecker.
Rob fears he is allergic to his own family.
Rob feels that he has betrayed his dentist friend, Jerry, when he goes to another dentist.
Rob must choose a Cleopatra for a community theater production.
After a string of burglaries in the neighborhood, the Petrie home is pillaged.
Laura believes her marriage is threatened by a singing weather girl.
Rob is slapped, kicked and screamed at by the girl he left behind when he entered the Army.
Rob unwittingly describes Laura as a "nut" on TV.
Rob leaves the show after Mel rejects his script and is upset when Buddy and Sally don't join him.
Rob leaves the show after Mel rejects his script and is upset when Buddy and Sally don't join him.
Rob fears a walnut will steal his imagination. Guest: Danny Thomas.
Laura tries to break Rob of his expensive habit of picking up the check.
Rob ignores Laura's warning to stay off the big slopes on his first skiing trip.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Jacques Savon, who has played a curious part in both Rob's and Laura's pasts, suddenly reappears.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
Guest host Tracy Rattigan is a charming but incorrigible flirt.
Rob finds himself caught in the middle after Buddy announces he is going to divorce Pickles.
Laura's old flame re-enters the Petries' lives as Alan Brady's newest sponsor.
Laura despairs when Rob learns of her elaborate plans to throw a surprise party for him.
Sally gets a marriage proposal from an opportunistic comedian who wants her to write his material.
Rob finds himself in hot water after inadvertently lifting a comedy idea from another show.
Rob reminisces about the joy and uneasiness of the day Ritchie was born.
Rob and Laura return home from an auction with two mysterious pieces of art.
Rob would like to know why Laura disappears every time his insurance agent comes over or calls.
Rob and Laura, having learned they are not legally married, make plans to elope.
Rob and Laura unintentionally eavesdrop on the Helpers prior to attending their dinner party.
Rob finds he has too many "stars" on his hands when he tries to direct this year's show.
Rob finds himself at a party in a strange town, dancing with a young woman.
Rob's energetic Uncle George comes for a visit to eagerly pressure Rob into finding him a wife.
An underworld figure involves Rob, Sally and Buddy in an unusual writing assignment.
Rob and Jerry's friendship is sorely tested when they buy a boat together.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.
Rob struggles between his civic duty and his fear for his family's safety.
The entire "Alan Brady" staff presents a Christmas show instead of the script.
A young chorus girl on "The Alan Brady Show" falls desperately in love with Rob.
Rob finds himself in trouble when Laura interferes with an interview he is giving on Alan Brady.
When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.
Laura meets her old love and discovers he has entered the priesthood.
A social game of poker turns sour when it's discovered Rob has been playing with a marked deck.
Laura and Rob give Ritchie a birthday party and 63 screaming moppets make a shambles of their house.
