This comedy gem introduces Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case!
Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must find a high-profile culprit quickly, or his career will be finit!

programmes.t: The Return Of The Pink Panther
programmes.d: When the Pink Panther Diamond is stolen from a museum, the intrepid Inspector Clouseau is on the case.
Chief Inspector Dreyfus is finally driven mad by Inspector Clouseau's (Peter Sellers) incompetence.
Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead.
When boozing Monty's mother-in-law leaves him an inheritance, he must change his ways before he can collect!
Wacky millionaire Thornton Melon enrolls in college...and higher education will never be the same again!
Four conniving jewel thieves compete for a fortune in jewels in this outrageously funny farce
A whip-smart comedy about two female friends and the oddball loser who may come between them.
When a man meets a handsome migrant on his family's farm, he must deal with emotions he has never felt before.
The kids at Western Summit High have "issues," and newcomer Charlie Bartlett is coming to their rescue.
An engaged man meets the perfect girl... at his bachelor party. And turns out she's cousins with his fiancee!
A superstitious widow is ready to remarry...until she falls in love with her fiancé's brother!
Cher, Winona Ryder, and Christina Ricci shine as an unpredictable mother and her two quirky daughters.
Marlene Dietrich stars in an exceptional courtroom drama about a man on trial for a wealthy widow's murder.
Billy Wilder's bawdy, charming and romantic farce about a French policeman who falls in love with a prostitute
A TV cameraman is accidentally clobbered during a football game and is convinced to feign a serious injury.
Burt Lancaster and Tony Curtis star in this classic as a ruthless journalist and an unscrupulous press agent.

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.
Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programmes.t: To Live And Die In L.A.
programmes.d: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend  (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.
A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!
A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.
After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…
When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change…hideously!

An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.
In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!
Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

When a beautiful alien hybrid (Natasha Henstridge) escapes from his lab, a scientist (Ben Kingsley) hires a team of experts to find her before she is able to mate and produce offspring. It’s a desperate battle and the fate of humanity is at stake!

When an astronaut morphs into an alien entity, impregnating women with deadly results, a clone of Eve (Natasha Henstridge) is sent to hunt him down. But they underestimate Eve’s maternal drive…and now only the strongest species will survive!

The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.

When a rocket lands on Mars, the crew finds the planet not entirely dead. As the team begins to explore, they are attacked by horrific and demented creatures at every turn. Battling for their lives, can the survivors make it back to their ship?
The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.
One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.

Norman Taylor has been enjoying unusual success at work lately, but could it be due to the magic his wife practices in secret? Infuriated upon discovering her methods, he destroys her protective spells, putting both their lives in mortal danger.
The demented Doctor Blood thinks he can create the “perfect" human from a corpse. But when he needs a live donor, his neighbors begin to vanish!
A Canadian Mountie and his trusty steed search a summer cheerleading camp to find a deranged lunatic...in a camp full of deranged lunatics!
When a physician accidentally swallows experimental bat serum pills, he finds himself saving patients by day…and sucking their blood by night!
Dracula flees Europe and ends up in a small California town. And his ravenous thirst is quickly turning the Golden State into…the ghoulish state!
In 18th century Europe, a vampire with lesbian tendencies ravages the young girls and townsfolk who, years earlier, killed off her fellow vampires.
Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!
When a soldier encounters a haunting woman on a desolate beach, his hunt for her leads to a dark, foreboding castle and its mysterious owner.

Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.
Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programmes.t: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programmes.d: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programmes.t: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programmes.d: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.
Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

Lisa Garr talks with expert numerologist Glynis McCants. Known as “The Numbers Lady,” she talks about the history of Numerology as a numbers system and as a science used by Pythagoras forward. She explains about your life path & your personal year.

Lisa Garr talks with Nadine Artemis, founder of natural skin care company Living Libations, about how most “natural” beauty products contain traces of chemicals. Artemis believes that each plant has a certain vibration which can be used in healing.

Lisa Garr talks with author and spiritual teacher Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati about knowing when to trust a deep, inner calling. She was completing her Ph.D. at Stanford when she left America to live in India, where she has been for over 25 years.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
After his son dies by suicide, a father seeks answers for what is killing today's youth.

The last two surviving members of the Piripkura people, a nomadic tribe in the Mato Grasso region of Brazil, struggle to maintain their indigenous way of life amidst the region's massive deforestation.

programmes.t: Boobs: The War On Women's Breast
programmes.d: The films investigates the controversy swirling around the breast cancer screening test mammography.

Alcohol is the world’s most powerful drug. Four billion people drink it regularly and the number is rising. Of the world’s 30 countries with the highest per capita alcohol consumption, no fewer than 26 are in Europe. Big business with 3 million victims each year. But who profits from all this?

Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

SHARING THE HARVEST follows farmers who reject conventional agriculture's growth pressures. Filmmaker Philipp Petruch explores three solidarity farming initiatives aiming to build sustainable, community-supported food systems. Through community, courage, and a new consumer-producer relationship, they show how we can transform agriculture - and the world.

programmes.t: JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC
programmes.d: Lack of physical activity is a growing problem, with over 50% of adults and 80% of young people in high-income countries being insufficiently active. The documentary JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC shows how we can reignite the desire for movement and overcome inactivity.
In Sun City, the retirement community in Arizona, the residents show us how to make the best of life when death casts its shadow in old age – with attitude!
We discuss how new parents can fuel their love life. Plus, ways to get more creative during foreplay. These topics and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.
How often do men really think about sex? Plus, we talk about ways to maintain intimacy when you're both the caretaker and the lover.
Alcohol may help get you in the mood but how does it affect your sex life? And do men fake orgasms? All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

Between work, family, and wellness, many women feel like they're running on empty. Mona shares empowering tools and mindset shifts to help women balance it all—without burning out. Fulfillment is possible when you root into what matters.

In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.
Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

We live in a fear-based world. In today’s lesson, Anita offers you tools that have been specially created to overcome your fears with love. This is the greatest lesson she learned during her near-death experience when she traveled to the other side. It’s the lesson that saved her life.

Today’s meditation will guide you through forgiveness. Of letting go of obstacles and fears that hold you back from living the life you desire to live. By doing so, you’ll be able to forgive everyone who has hurt you in this life, release emotional baggage that may be weighing heavy on you, and step into a new realm of possibility.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day Three of Teaching the Teachers reveals that the ego conceals our perfect, God-created Self. We are not our bodies, and life continues beyond birth and death. Thoughts create effects, yet through atonement we can be freed from guilt, fear, and suffering when we choose healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Day 1 welcomes you to Desire Mapping—an approach to living guided by how you want to feel, not just what you want to do. By shifting from goal lists to heart-centered intention, this introduction invites you to honor presence, intuition, and the feelings that shape a fulfilling life.

programmes.d: Having terminated two pregnancies for Lanre, Grace refuses to abort a third pregnancy for the man she has devoted her best years to, especially when she believes they are destined to get married. When Grace chooses her baby, Lanre breaks his promise of marriage, leaving her to face an uncertain future alone.

Los adultos mayores colombianos están perdiendo casas y negocios por ser estafados por sus abogados.

Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

En Florencia, Caquetá, Lina, embarazada de siete meses, fue asesinada frente a su casa. Aunque el sicario escapó, un testigo señaló a Marmolejo, pareja de la víctima y padre de su bebé, como el autor intelectual del crimen. Pruebas contundentes, incluyendo el testimonio del propio pistolero, confirman que Marmolejo contrató el asesinato para deshacerse de Lina y estar con otra mujer.

Alberto Elías Orozco, empresario dueño de la fábrica "Yogurozco" en Cali, fue asesinado junto a su esposa Macclly Arbeláez en marzo de 2012 cuando se dirigían a misa. Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.
Heidy Guzmán, de 10 años, desapareció en Tolima en 2007. Fue hallada sin vida tras dos semanas. La investigación reveló abuso y homicidio.

Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

Lola, del icónico programa infantil Plaza Sésamo, comparte cómo ella y el equipo de producción se adaptaron a la pandemia mediante video llamadas para seguir conectando con los niños. También hablan sobre los programas humanitarios de la organización, incluyendo su iniciativa más reciente para ayudar a los niños refugiados sirios desplazados por más de una década de guerra en Medio Oriente.

Luz Mary y Yon Fredy, tras perder tres embarazos, esperaban con ilusión a su bebé Salvador. En medio del paro nacional de 2021 en Colombia, con un embarazo de alto riesgo, quedaron atrapados en un bloqueo de manifestantes en el peaje de Sisga camino a Bogotá. Aunque finalmente los dejaron pasar, ya era demasiado tarde: perdieron a su bebé y con él, todas sus ilusiones de ser padres.

Michael dice que él y Britny no tuvieron relaciones sexuales lo suficiente como para que ella quedara embarazada. Shekeita y su hermana Natasha están aquí para demostrar que Kieary es el verdadero padre del bebé de Shekeita.

Monica tenía una relación con Deshan. Pero él y su madre, Tayama, afirman que solo fue una aventura de una sola vez. Más tarde, los rumores impiden que Joshua reclame al hijo de Deshan, ¡Joshua Jr.! ¿Quién es el padre biológico de Joshua Jr.?

Danica, una nueva mamá, recibió 5 correos electrónicos diferentes de 5 mujeres asegurando que se acostaron con su novio, Jimmy, en su casa. Entonces, ¿el novio de Renee preferirá su adicción a su familia?
Tina dejó a "G" tras revelar su embarazo y sufrir abusos. Sospecha que Patrice siembra dudas para separarlos. "G" dice que ella lo acosa, pero asegura querer estar presente en la vida del hijo.
¿Quién es responsable del bienestar del pequeño Noel? Todo el mundo puede negar las acusaciones, pero alguien sabe qué pasó, y Steve va a obtener explicaciones.
Deja enfrenta al padre de su hijo por el número de su amiga; Christian quiso hacer lo correcto tras un bebé pero estuvo con otra; Davonta dice que su ex está loca y quiere ser libre.

Otro hombre puede frustrar los planes de Devin de tener una relación con una estudiante universitaria; Zhane descubre quién ha estado ocupando el tiempo de su novio; Emily y su hermano se enteran de que sus parejas se han vuelto demasiado cercanas.

Percy debe elegir entre la madre de su bebé y su otra mujer; Mary se entera de que su prometido se ha acostado con su amiga; Casey se pregunta si debería volver con un hombre que miente constantemente.
¡Es la batalla de los ex! Tony lucha para recuperar a su ex-amante. Richard le cuenta a su esposa que ha tenido un romance y ve a Lisa, su ex-amante, luchar por recuperarlo.
Danny planea dejar a la madre de su hijo por una stripper; Richard le confiesa a su prometida que la engañó mientras ella estaba encerrada; Dorreon quiere poner fin a su relación.
Cuando dos granjeros conocidos desaparecen, la policía rastrea un teléfono para encontrar al sospechoso.

Se sigue el rastro de denuncias ciudadanas sobre maltrato animal, feminicidios, negligencia en geriátricos y cirugías estéticas. Casos de justicia demorada y respuestas ciudadanas que exigen sanciones y reformas, luchando por la verdad y la justicia.

Miles de familias colombianas buscan tener casa propia, pero muchas son engañadas. En San Gil, José Luis Sierra y otros invirtieron en un proyecto de vivienda que resultó ser una estafa. En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. En Bogotá, Daniel Gómez ofreció rentabilidades del 8% con su empresa Taurex, pero tampoco cumplió. La criptomoneda Daily Cop también dejó a miles sin su dinero. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco sigue siendo un enigma. José Manuel Gnecco, principal sospechoso, insiste en su inocencia, mientras nuevas pruebas y la controversia sobre el arma homicida complican aún más el caso.

Ante la creciente delincuencia y la ineficacia policial, los ciudadanos recurren a la seguridad privada, la unión y vigilancia organizada surgen como respuesta urgente, evidenciando vacíos en la justicia y protección policial.
En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

Una historia de amor en Barranquilla termina en tragedia en Canadá. Patricia es asesinada por su esposo al descubrir infidelidad. Tras un juicio, él es condenado. Los hijos quedan al cuidado del hermano de Daniel.

En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

En 1993, Nancy Mestre, de 18 años, fue violada y asesinada por Jaime Saade Cormane tras salir con él en Nochevieja. Su padre, Martín, nunca se rindió: pasó 27 años investigando hasta descubrir que Saade había huido a Brasil bajo una nueva identidad. Gracias a su persistencia, fue capturado en 2020, aunque la extradición a Colombia sigue pendiente.

Carmenza López exige respuestas sobre el asesinato de su esposo Guillermo Leal, edil de Sumapaz secuestrado por las FARC en 2008. Aunque recibió un cuerpo, ella duda que fueran sus restos. Trece años después, sigue buscando la verdad, ahora como miembro de la Mesa de víctimas de Sumapaz, enfrentando a los desmovilizados sin darles el perdón que aún no siente merecido.

Estos invitados dicen que están seguros de saber quién es el padre de sus hijos, pero necesitan una prueba de ADN para comprobarlo. Ahora los resultados están a punto de descubrirse, pero ¿serán los resultados que esperaban?

El año pasado, Maurice fue descubierto engañando a Karen en The Maury Show y ha vuelto con su nueva prometida, Shauntia. ¿Sigue siendo infiel? Entonces, Destanee, de 17 años, cree que el padre de su bebé la engaña... ¡con su madre!

¡Estas mujeres han venido con preguntas urgentes! Kendra quiere que su esposo Richard admita que es el padre de su hijo Y del hijo de su amante! ¡Jevon y su familia no creen que él sea el padre del hijo de Jazmine! ¡Solo MAURY tiene las respuestas!

Wang Won, the crown prince of the Goryeo Dynasty, visits Lee Seung Hyu with his friend Wang Rin.
As it gets dark, Wang Won and Wang Rin spend a night in a cave with Eun San.
Wang Jeon asks permission of Eun Yeong Baek, the father of Eun San, to marry her.
Wang Won tries to find the one who shot an arrow at King Chung Ryeol to prove Wang Rin's innocence.
Due to Song In's trick, Eun San is caught as one of the attackers of the King's assassination.
Song In gets to know Eun San's identity and forces her to marry Wang Jeon.
While Wang Rin tries hard to mar Eun San's marriage talks, Wang Won senses the uneasy atmosphere.
King Chung Ryeol becomes furious when he hears that Wang Won interfered in Wang Jeon's marriage.
Wang Rin puts up himself to save his sister Wang Dan.
Princess Won Seong and Song In capture Eun Yeong Baek and Eun San, coveting their property.
To provide support, Princess Won Seong fetches Lee Seung Hyu for Wang Won.
Wang Won comes up against King Chung Ryeol to get back Eun San.
To stop Eun San from leaving, Wang Won reinvestigates the Sungjookjae incident.
Princess Won Seong orders Eun San to testify on the Sungjookjae incident to ruin Wang Rin's family.
Wang Rin wants to protect Eun San, who is devastated at her father's death.
Wang Rin and Eun San are chased by Jang Ui, Princess Won Seong's men, and King Chung Ryeol's men.
Wang Rin announces that he would marry Eun San but Wang Won detains Rin and brings San to his place.
Discovering the truth of Princess Won Seong's death, Wang Won loses his temper.
Wang Won gets to know Wang Rin's real intention and gains powerful political position with his help.
Wang Won, Wang Rin, and Eun San makes their own resolution to save Goryeo from Yuan.
Hong Deok Su and Prince Mu Yeong join Yongcheonru as apprentices, each with their own hidden motives.
Disguised as Lee Eun Ho, the prince keeps a close eye on Deok Su as he attempts to retrieve the golden key.
Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.

Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?
Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.

Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emmanuel Karpathakis fear a cyclist with glass sticking out of his neck could bleed out. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

Dr Terry Kane faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones fears his forgetfulness could be a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital Dr Andrew Trezise worries a young dirt bike rider has life-altering injuries after a crash. Dr Jonathan Papson fears for a showjumper who is in agony with multiple breaks after being thrown off a horse.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Jonathan Papson discovers devastating news for an injured driver. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

Australia’s ambulance crews fight to save lives in a race against time. Taz and rookie Amanda treat a swimmer who collapses after leaving a sauna. Matt takes flight to help a two-year-old who’s fallen unconscious and stopped breathing.

Mark and Carina race to help a critically injured paraglider who’s crashed into a cliff. A creepy case of bed bugs makes Michelle nervous. Jamie and Mike struggle to convince a cyclist hit by a car that she needs to go to hospital.

A severe asthma attack has Mark and Carina battling to save a young woman struggling to breathe. Nat and Leonard rush to aid an elderly man who’s convinced his chest pain is a heart attack, just like the one which claimed his dad’s life. But are his symptoms masking another injury? Taz and Amanda find a fun way of deciding who gets to drive the ambulance for the day. Matt and his helicopter crew airlift a trauma patient to hospital after a high impact car crash.

A heartbreaking fall for a 98-year-old who lives alone has Taz and Amanda mounting a delicate rescue mission. Afterwards they are shocked by vicious abuse from the public. Nat and Leonard respond to a suspected drug overdose at a trendy shopping strip. As the pair attempt to treat the young man, they get a surprise when police arrive on the scene. Ray and his air ambulance crew brave sub-zero temperature, poor night visibility and difficult terrain to rescue a badly injured emergency volunteer.

Nat and Leonard battle to keep an 81-year-old woman alive after a suspected stroke. Every second counts as Taz and Amanda race to a child trapped in a car outside a kindergarten, but they struggle to find the location. Ray and the air ambulance crew help a motorcycle accident victim who’s shattered knee could cost him his leg. A missing item of clothing has Nicola and Michelle scratching their heads. Mike and Jamie are taken aback by a primary school boy’s shocking playground injury.

Matt treats a worker burnt in an explosion, but bad weather jeopardises the flight to hospital. Nicola and Risky race to save an 85-year-old woman struggling to breathe at the wheel of her car. Leonard’s love life is brought into the spotlight when Nat and a patient both press him to propose marriage. Mark has to deal with a misbehaving driver who’s crashed into a pole. Mike and Jamie aid a motorcycle accident victim more concerned about what his wife will say than his own wellbeing.

Mark is called to a volatile emergency as a young man leaps from a moving car and goes on a rampage, causing mayhem. Ray and the air ambulance crew race to aid a camper stranded on a remote mountain with a broken leg as night closes in. A nurse becomes a patient after a car crash leaves her struggling to breathe. Amanda and Leonard treat a tourist so badly injured in a skateboarding accident that she may not be able to return home.

A critically ill patient phones for help before falling unconscious inside her home, forcing paramedics to attempt a break in. Mark and Carina treat a man with a life-threatening condition, where the only way to save him is to stop his heart. Jamie’s good humour is tested by a crying toddler with a nasty case of croup. Nicola and Risky attend an elderly woman suffering a suspected heart attack, who’s more concerned about letting her friends down than her own perilous health.

The air ambulance crew rush to a frightened car crash survivor whose memory loss has Matt concerned. Mark must keep his emotions in check as he treats a toddler with severe burns, whilst trying to reassure the distressed parents. A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled as to what’s wrong. Risky and Nicola attempt to help a 60-year-old with a broken wrist, but are confronted by an unwanted intruder who escalates the situation.

Mark races to help a young father of three who’s in danger of losing his arm, which got caught in a factory conveyor belt. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction and several walking wounded, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation. Matt takes charge of a precarious rescue in mountain ranges, where a driver is trapped in his car. Amanda rushes to help a sick baby, but quickly succumbs to his infectious smile.

At Australia’s Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Emma West faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, but he’s putting up a fight. Drs Jonathan Papson and Mya Cubitt race to save the life of a young man whose car slammed into a pole. Dr Mark Putland treats a factory worker who’s in shock after being confronted with his horrific life-changing injuries. A heavily pregnant young woman presents a challenge for Dr Michelle Thornhill.

A gunshot victim arrives at The Royal Melbourne Hospital under police guard. Dr Sarah Whitelaw fears the patient could die from his injuries, but the shooter is still at large, posing a risk. Dr Jonathan Papson treats a football player who could bleed to death from kidney damage, after an on-field collision. Dr Michael Dunne and nurse Lucy Stranger assess a pregnant car crash patient who can’t feel her baby move. Dr Michelle races to the waiting room after a woman mysteriously collapses.

Dr Fiona Nicholson uses her reassuring bedside manner on a young man with a racing heart and spiking blood pressure - but she’ll have to stop his heart beating in order to save him. A patient with a gruesome head wound has Dr Sarah Whitelaw on full alert, and unseen internal injuries could make things even worse. Nurse Julia Hoiles helps a smitten young couple who spend their first date in emergency. Dr Michael Dunne treats a nurse-to-be who has smashed her leg in a car accident.

A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Every moment counts, as the unconscious patient has severe blood loss. Dr Lauren Cohen treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff. 20-year-veteran Dr Tom Razga treats the ‘walking wounded’ in triage, reassuring a highly anxious woman who has a small wound. Is Dr Michelle Thornhill’s patient constipated from pasta or is it more serious?

A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Miriam Yassa is on high alert for the baby’s welfare, and the cause of the mum-to-be’s collapse. Dr Sarah Whitelaw treats a cyclist after a car hit him from behind. He can’t remember the accident or feel his feet. Support volunteer Jean is on hand for comfort and cups of tea and is a welcome distraction for stressed patients.

Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Every second counts as new partners Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victims of a brutal assault. Intensive Care Paramedic Al races to the scene of a motorbike accident, where a tourist’s life hangs in the balance after colliding with a fallen tree. Flight Paramedic Ray treats an unlucky gardener with a shocking injury, but will the helicopter flight make his condition worse? And its all about the love for Taz and Amanda.

Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall. A shocking motorcycle accident in the high country leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Single responder Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Mike and Eamon respond to an emergency at the city’s busiest railway station, where a man who’s already survived six heart attacks is in a bad way.

Experienced paramedics Doddsy and Carina rush to help a horse trainer who’s in critical condition after being kicked in the face. Matt and the Air Ambulance crew attempt a difficult winch rescue to help a paraglider who has crashed in remote bushland. An out-of-control patient at a busy train station puts Taz and Amanda to the test. Newlywed Leonard has some exciting news to share, before he and Nat rush to help a newborn baby caught in a hit and run.

Taz and Amanda help a patient who has mysteriously collapsed at work in front of panicked customers. Flight Paramedic Ray rushes to help a young mother who has been badly injured in a high impact road accident, and is desperate to find her baby girl. It’s a race against time for Eamon and Mike as they rush to get a first-time mother to hospital before she gives birth. With a 40-kilometre journey ahead of them and contractions speeding up, will Eamon have to deliver the baby?

Single responder Cullen races to the scene of a road accident, where a motorcyclist is unconscious and fighting for his life. Carina and Doddsy battle heavy traffic to save a child’s life, as his distraught mother performs CPR on the side of the road. Taz and Amanda treat a dog bite victim who becomes unpredictable. MICA paramedic Glenice hikes to reach an injured teenager, after a selfie expedition on a stretch of rugged coastline ends in disaster.

Amanda and Nicola rush to help to a terrified woman who is having a major heart attack. Medication will buy them time, but surgery is the only thing that can save her life. Leonard and Nat are called to a major traffic accident where a trapped driver is showing worrying signs of a devastating head injury. Doddsy and Carina treat a mountain bike rider with shocking facial injuries. Eamon and Mike play referee between an embarrassed allergy patient and his protective Mum.

Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case and help a young man with severe chest pain? A nervous drive to hospital for Leonard and Amanda, who’s laid back patient has major problems. Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. An out of control heart rate puts a Mum of 5 in the danger zone, and Ray helps a young woman who has been in a major car accident on a country road.

Amanda has a surprise in store to celebrate Taz’s ten years in the service, but the party is on hold as they rush to help a patient who’s had a fall. Cam answers a dangerous callout to save a man in personal crisis. Carina and Doddsy are on edge as they treat a woman who’s suffering a severe allergic reaction after being stung by a bee. Mike and Eamon’s concerns grow for a newlywed couple who've been thrown from their motorbike. Ray heads bush to help a dirtbike rider in trouble.

A bumpy ride as Amanda and Taz rush to a foster Mum in agony. Flight paramedic Matt races to help a teenage student in a critical condition after high jump practice ends in disaster. Can Nat and Leonard convince their laid back patient to come to hospital, after tests show he may be suffering a ‘silent’ heart attack? Eamon works his charms on a distressed cyclist who’s had a run in with a classic Melbourne hazard. Cullen attends an horrific car accident that’s left a young driver trapped.

A gripping emergency airlift for a woman who’s suffered a massive stroke. Risky and Nicola assess a great grandmother in serious pain, but what’s causing it? A fun day at a waterpark turns into a nightmare, as single-responder Al finds a patient with suspected spinal injuries. A high-impact collision has flight paramedic Matt heading to the coast, where a grandmother and her two granddaughters are in serious strife. Cam and Doddsy’s patients refuse to go to hospital without their beloved dog.

Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a volatile man who’s been on a two-day drug bender, putting himself and staff at risk. Dr Jonathan’s patient has a shocking fracture after falling four metres from a ladder. Dr Luke examines a man who has collapsed at home and suffered deep facial bruising, but what caused the fall? Dr Emma calls in reinforcements to save a mum whose life hangs in the balance after a high-speed crash on a country road.

A grandfather of nine has a broken leg and massive blood loss after a motorbike accident, but his vital signs aren’t showing Dr Jana Alexander and Dr Jonathan Papson the danger he’s in. A teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. However, the potentially career-ending injury is not Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing jewellery from swollen fingers, which isn’t something he learned in medical school.

At Royal Melbourne Emergency, a young abattoir worker is in agony after amputating her fingers. Dr Bjorn Makein and Nurse Sarah Thomas must stop the bleeding if there’s any chance of saving the woman’s hand. Dr Emma West’s patient has major head injuries after falling down stairs on her way to a wedding. Dr Michelle Thornhill treats a cyclist who’s come off his bike while not wearing a helmet. Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

A crane operator crushed under falling steel at work is rushed to Royal Melbourne Emergency. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats a pregnant woman who is semi-conscious and behaving erratically. Dr Michelle Thornhill reassures a man who has impaled a drill bit through his hand. But how will she get it out? Dr Scott Taylor recommends an electric shock to reset a father-of-two’s dangerously fast heartbeat.

Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, a pregnant woman survives a car accident. Now, Dr Emma West must stop the terrified mum going into premature labour. Dr Sarah Whitelaw and the team battle to save a teen driver who’s rolled his car, is unresponsive, and has serious head injuries. Dr Scott Taylor fears a diabetic man might need an amputation. A trail bike rider has crashed face-first. Despite his injuries, he impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his resilience and wit.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, Drs Emma and Jonathan battle to save a father of two from bleeding to death after he’s thrown from a horse. Where’s he bleeding from? Dr Luke looks for the cause of a law student’s puzzling condition which has terrified her worried parents. Dr Michelle’s young patient is in agony from broken bones after a motorbike accident and doesn’t want his parents to know. Dr George has grave fears for a handy-man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete while helping a mate.

Heart stopping moments at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe after multiple heart attacks. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from his backyard hive. Everything changes in a moment as he races to attend a stabbing victim who has no pulse. Nurse Sarah searches for the baby’s heartbeat after a pregnant woman is injured in a car crash.

Every second counts at Royal Melbourne Emergency as injured people keep arriving. Dr Luke treats a tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks! Dr Jonathan is concerned for a uni student who’s fallen six metres from the famous Hanging Rock. Dr Michelle treats a young motorcyclist with broken wrists who’s kept his bike a secret from his parents. Dr Martin helps a mum of two with a painful burn injury caused by boiling pasta.

The pressure is on for Mike and Eamon, who arrive at the scene of a car accident only to find their patient has been stabbed and is rapidly losing blood. Nat and Leonard help a golfer who’s feeling sub-par. Matt airlifts a motorcyclist who has a collapsed lung, after a head on with a kangaroo. Glenice meets a hero dog that raises the alarm when his owner is knocked unconscious after being thrown from her horse. Amanda and Taz’s patient has intense chest pains, but is it a heart attack?

Can flight paramedic Ray save the life of a high-country farmer with a dangerously blocked heart? Cam earns the trust of a toddler in trouble, after she suffers an allergic reaction. A volatile patient puts Taz and Amanda in the line of fire. Leonard and Nat treat a young Mum, terrified she’s been bitten by a funnel web spider. Eamon and Mike help a woman with chest pains and breathing issues, but what’s causing it?

Cam responds to a call from frantic parents whose son has fallen through a glass window and is bleeding to death. A father son weekend becomes a Dad’s worst nightmare when his little boy is struggling to breathe. Leonard and Nicola help a grandmother in excruciating pain with a fractured hip. A young man suffering a rare condition has Doddsy on high alert. Mike and Eamon are confronted with a shocking Martial Arts injury, and Risky stops by with a special little visitor.

Felipe viaja a Bogotá en busca de trabajo y deja a Lina María en Montería.
Felipe sigue arriesgando su vida en Bogotá.
Cristian intenta negar y evitar su creciente atracción por Lina.
Felipe está cada vez más cerca de ser llevado ante la justicia.
Sonia le dice a Christian que sospecha que Lina se ha desenamorado de Felipe.
Leo está emocionado por ir a la fiesta de trabajo de Felipe, pero lo descarta al instante.
Los celos de Cristian hacia José crecen a medida que la gente habla de él y Lina.

A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?
Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.

A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.
The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.
Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.
A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

A featherweight battle between this week’s rounds. Robots that weigh no more than 12kg battle to join the other qualifiers. The main competition proceeds as evenly matched robots do anything they can to get the upper hand.
Canada and Switzerland both battle in the World Championship Qualifier special event. The heats near their end and spots for the final are filling up rapidly and to a high standard.

It’s all-out war as Refbot is immobilised and Sir Killalot may have finally met his match. One round ends exceptionally quickly. Another World Championship Qualifier between three Dutch robots is this week’s special event.

The last of the heats, the final eight robots that have a chance of making it to the Grand Final, will they seize the opportunity or choke under the pressure? A featherweight champion will be revealed in this week’s special event.

Eight of the heat winners gather for the first Semi-Finals. With two rounds to prove themselves, only two robots will make it to the Grand Finals. Competitors show no mercy as they use any means necessary to eliminate their opponents.

One competitor’s weapon proves fatal for their opposition, crushing their hopes of a title with a single blow, whilst other unlucky robots are removed from not only the arena, but also the competition.

The Grand Final is here as the series draws to an explosive end. With every battle being so well matched, the judges have their work cut out for them as they decide which robot, will become Robot Wars: The Seventh Wars champions.

Twelve Robots from across the globe once again gather in the arena for the Third World Championship. Eliminator style rounds will decide which robots progress through to the finals, where a winner will be crowned.
Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.
Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?
The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?
A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?
A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

Let the battle for the Third Wars crown commence. With the trials being replaced with all out combat, this series is set to be the most brutal yet.

Teams from across the UK enter the arena in hopes of besting the house robots and making it to the Grand Final. The knockouts keep on coming as eight more competitors think they have what it takes to survive the Robot Wars.
Eight fresh competitors ready to prove their mettle in the arena. Featuring a special event, Middleweight Melee, a single exhibition battle between five robots weighing under 45.4kg.
As the knockouts continue to streamline the competition, this week’s special has separate competitors trying to knock-down objects and hit targets to score the most points in Pinball Warriors.

Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.
This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.
The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.
Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.
Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
A delivery girl Jan Di enters a prestigious high school, where she becomes the target of elitist bullies.
Jan Di defies against Joon Pyo's humiliation. He doesn't know what to make of her open disgust.
The Mean Girls Trio fancies Joon Pyo, who fancies Jan Di, who fancies Ji Hoo, who fancies Seo Hyun.
When the students acknowledge Jan Di as Joon Pyo's official girlfriend, they all start to betray Jan Di.
After officially declaring Jan Di his girlfriend, Joon Pyo takes her and others to his private getaway.
A triangle has developed between Jan Di, Ji Hoo and Joon Pyo.
Joon Pyo's sister, Joon Hee, intervenes on behalf of her brother and his friends with a trial.
After the competition ends, Ji Hoo asks Jan Di out on a date, but she finds herself thinking of Joon Pyo.
Having overnighted with Jan Di's family, Joon Pyo gets immersed in their commoner lifestyle and habits.
After Joon Pyo makes a public fool of himself, Hee Soo takes actions to remove Jan Di from his social garden.
A mysterious supermodel saves Jan Di from exploitative pornographers, but he puts her in even greater danger.
Joon Pyo gets mad over Jan Di losing another gift, neither aware that the item was purposefully stolen.
A hospital diagnosis strikes at Jan Di. While Jun Pyo is away, Ji Hoo sees Jan Di through her low point.
In Macau, the rest of F4 intervene on Jan Di's behalf. Joon Pyo has made a Devil's bargain with Hee Soo.
Everybody wonders if the Joon Pyo & Jan Di relationship is truly over.
Jae Kyung asks "little sister" Jan Di to help her win over Joon Pyo.
Memories of the past haunt several people as Jae Kyung steps up efforts to woo the heart of Joon Pyo.
Joon Pyo learns of Jan Di's injury and makes a "practice" move for independence.
A game of Truth or Dare and a chance meeting start striking at the heart of matters while Hee Soo launches another assault on Jan Di's world.
Andy and Gail go undercover as cocktail waitresses to clean up a drug-infested club.
As a full moon hangs over the city, the rookies are unnerved by a series of strange occurrences.
As 15 Division recovers from the shooting of Callaghan, a series of arsons culminates in a laundromat fire.
Using a car dealership, 15 Division runs a sting operation to crack down on suspects with outstanding warrants
When an informant is murdered, 15 Division sets its sights on finding a weak link in the East Jameson gang.
When a woman is attacked in the same way as a deceased cop. Callaghan is convinced that it’s the same suspect.
After a seemingly drunken man collapses in the barn, 15 Division is put under quarantine.

On an undercover training exercise Traci and Andy stumble upon a woman who is about to die of an overdose.

When a girl vanishes from the scene of a multi-car accident, Andy connects the girl to a 7-year-old cold case.
As high schools wind to a close for summer, dangerous pranks abound – including the theft of a police car.
Dov Epstein happens upon a convenience store robbery-in-progress that results in him shooting a black teenager
Hell breaks loose when a carload of girls from a bachelorette party hits another vehicle, killing the driver.
When Andy answers a domestic disturbance call, the social worker turns out to be her estranged mother.

A gifted psychic (or a gifted conman) helps find the missing witness in an organized-crime case.
While investigating the disappearance of an escort, the officers discover a pattern of missing women.
The officers of 15 Division are forced to release a suspected predator for lack of evidence.
The officers of 15 Division are reeling in the aftermath of the unexpected death of one of their colleagues.
Staff Sergeant Frank Best decides it_s time for his officers to get back on track.
Andy and Nick investigate a torched van. It belongs a street priest who's been receiving death threats.
When a child abductor escapes from an emergency hospital visit, 15 Division goes on the hunt for the criminal.
After months working undercover, Andy and Nick’s operation goes sideways when Nick - then Andy - go missing.
On her first day back at 15 Division, Andy must work with Swarek to track down an ex-convict.
Andy is partnered with Swarek’s new girlfriend, Officer Marlo Cruz.
A routine highway check leads to the discovery of a teenage boy in the trunk of a car.
After a messy drug arrest, Andy and Marlo are quarantined together.
There's a possible connection between a missing woman and one of the division’s most distressing cases.
When human bones found in a ravine open up a 15-year-old case, Swarek reunites with his old training officer.
Things get complicated when the team gets called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens.
When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted.
Near the end of a shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op.
When a pedophile is found beaten, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting an off-hours “investigation."
Someone with a grudge against 15 Division opens fire on Andy and Chloe.
The officers have to piece together the truth about a past crime in order to find Oliver Shaw.
Andy and Dov pull themselves together at an all-night diner, but are caught off-guard in a diner hold-up.
Oliver gets promoted to Acting Staff Sergeant, and Andy is tasked with training 15 Division’s newest rookie.
Inspector Jarvis sends the officers to seize all “proceeds of crime” – anything purchased with illegal money.
After the discovery of an executed gang leader, 15 Division must find the killer before a gang war breaks out.
When 15 Division goes undercover at a club-land bar, Chris’s erratic behavior make Dov suspicious.
As the officers try to hunt down the killer of Brian Gowdy – Andy and Sam go on the road for interviews.
Oliver prepares Andy to defend herself at Duncan’s dismissal hearing, now happening two hours from now.
An innocuous call to a middle-class home puts Dov and Chris in the middle of a home invasion investigation.
15 Division works on a program to help tenants move out of a subsidized-housing complex that’s being torn down
Andy’s former rookie, Duncan, is back on duty and looking to reconcile – something she’s not ready for yet.
The officers work to find a bomber. But after catching him, they realize he has more targets set to explode.

Randy's runway show is finally here, and he needs to be ready.
Randy looks back on some of his favorite celebrity moments.

Samantha falls for a dress that's twice her budget.
